Florica is looking for a loving home at a reduced adoption donation of £200 from Romania with vet preparation and home drop off.

Let’s give Florica the peaceful retirement he truly deserves.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is a 9 year old male Shih Tzu who has come to us after his lady owner passed away and her husband was struggling to care for him.

He was in a real mess and we had to get a fabulous groomer to brave the matts before getting our vets to sedate him and do the rest.

The poor fella was a snappy, angry boy as he must have been in pain with all the matted fur and pulling him about.

Since then, he has settled into a foster home with dogs and is generally a good boy. He has learned to snap when he doesn’t want to be brushed but we are working through this with a little grooming every day and he has really improved.

He loves a good walk, sniffing around and investigating, however if a dog comes near he likes to tell them off (a little half-heartedly). He loves walking with his foster family’s dogs though.

So Milo is a typical Shih Tzu – if you have one you’ll know! Feisty, arrogant, with a swagger! Loves a lap and is affectionate and loyal.

Unfortunately, Milo has had to have his eye removed as it was ulcerated and not healing.

He’s acting like he doesn’t know how any different.

name: Harrison
description:
Harrison is a 12 to 18 months male Podenco old male Podenco located in Spain

This handsome young devil is Harrison, he is an unusual, rough-coated Podenco mix in black and white! He is quite tall and leggy, standing at 70cm and weighs around 30kg but he has a slimline body like a lurcher.

Poor Harrison was found wandering the streets for a few weeks before being caught, and as a typical hound, he was quite aloof for a few days until he settled in and understood it was safe at last. Now, Harrison is a big, hair, playful, loving puppy, who loves love and affection.

Only 12 to 18 months old, he enjoys toys, sharing with a large female atm but gradually being introduced to the main pack and no issues all very friendly.

We feel assured he will be a great hit with the male dogs too. Not yet tested for cats, and as he is gentle, we think he can live with Children over 10 years old.

Friendly, good looking and good with other dogs. Walks well on lead.

name: Benji
description:
Benji is a 3-year-old male Spitz. He was found as a stray, which might explain why he’s such a shy, nervous little soul.

But don’t let that fool you — beneath the cautious exterior is a loyal and loving dog just waiting for the right person to come along.

Benji’s journey hasn’t been the easiest, and that’s why he’ll need someone patient and experienced who understands that good things take time.

He’ll benefit massively from continued training and slow, steady encouragement in a calm, predictable environment.

He prefers the solo dog life and will need to be the only pup in the home.

Kids? Not quite his speed — he’d be happiest in an adult-only household where he can feel safe and secure.

A quiet home with access to a garden will give him the space he needs to build trust and confidence at his own pace.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross cane corso

name: Drew
description:
Drew is an 18 month old staffy cross cane Corso who we took in a few days ago. He is stunning!! He’s a big lad (weighing 33kg) and needs a home with large breed experience and the commitment to such a young and giddy boy.

Today he’s been to the vets for his vaccination and been an absolute gem. He’s travelled well in the car, loved everyone at the vets and enjoyed a wonderful walk (as well as giving a million kisses to his chauffeurs!).

He’s met other dogs and been fine with them so we would consider a home with a friendly speyed female or possibly an older neutered male (having two teenage males is not usually a recommended idea).

He’s not been around cats so no cats. And a home with respectful older kids 10+ who are used to large breed dogs.

He has been a delight with everyone he has met and ever enjoyed a good brush from the kennel staff.

He will need a home where he will get plenty of exercise and won’t be left for too long given his age as well as a secure garden for him to play in.

He’s strong on his lead initially but does settle and then wants to sniff and snuffle. He needs someone committed to his training and the fact he may go through his terrible twos!

He’s started his vaccinations today and will be neutered as part of the adoption process. He’s chipped.

Forever homes can be anywhere within the UK but you will need to travel to meet him in West Yorkshire.

As always we require everyone in the family and any children who are regularly going to be in contact with the dog to attend the meet.

Our usual process is that you will need to come and meet the dog and that adoption is then done on a second meet. For some dogs additional meets may be required and potential adopters will be required to travel to the dogs location for all meets.

If you are suited we will then arrange a homecheck, vet reference and meet with the dog.

We only rehome where all resident and previous animals are/were regularly vaccinated and neutered/speyed unless on veterinary advice. All of our dogs have rescue back up.

name: Chance and Dexter
description:
Chance and Dexter are two one year old German shepherd cross boys needing a new home due to the ill health of their owner which means they’re not receiving the walks they need.

Chance the white boy is anxious and needs some reassurance about the world, especially outside of the home.

Dexter the Black and Tan boy is more confident and can be quite bouncy.

Both are lovely dogs who will flourish in the right home.

Given their age and that they are litter brothers meaning they are likely to begin to have issues as they mature as many of similar ages do we think it is better to rehome them seperately but do think they would benefit from living with another dog for company.

Chance definitely needs the company of another dog to help him with confidence

They are both good with children 2+ and good with other dogs but a no to cats. We would therefore be happy to find them a home with a friendly speyed/neutered dog to keep them company.

We are told they are ok to be left for reasonable periods of time.

They are not yet neutered but this will be done as part of the adoption process. They are both vaccinated and chipped.

Forever homes can be anywhere within the UK but you will need to travel to meet them where they are in South Yorkshire.

As always we require everyone in the family and any children who are regularly going to be in contact with the dog to attend the meet.

Our usual process is that you will need to come and meet the dog and that adoption is then done on a second meet. For some dogs additional meets may be required and potential adopters will be required to travel to the dogs location for all meets.

If you are suited we will then arrange a homecheck, vet reference and meet with the dog.

We only rehome where all resident and previous animals are/were regularly vaccinated and neutered/speyed unless on veterinary advice. All of our dogs have rescue back up.

name: Pixel
description:
Pixel is an 11 year old male Mioritic Shepherd and is large in size. He currently lives with a foster family and is looking for his forever home.

He’s very chilled and placid and will sit by you to be fussed—he’s a very loyal boy and will stay by your side.

Pixel can be a little wary of new people in the house and therefore would need slow and steady introductions with visitors, but once he knows you he will come for attention.

On walks, Pixel will wear a collar, lead and harness and loves to be out and about. He’s a slow walker, plods along at his own pace and is very calm. Outside noises do not phase him.

He’s very sociable with other dogs in the household and can live with other dogs. Pixel loves his food and is very food orientated which helps with his training.

He’s very obedient and comes straight away to his name being called. However, when left alone, food will need to be put away as he’s cheeky and has been known to steal bags of crisps and even a loaf of bread off the side.

Pixel is toilet trained, sleeps well overnight alone or in the room with his foster family. He travels well in the car and can be left home alone without any issues.

Pixel is a lovely old boy who would love to find a family of his own to enjoy the rest of his life with lots of happiness and love around him.

name: Jakob
description:
Jakob is a 10 year old male Cross-Breed and is medium in size. He enjoys his walks and walks well on a lead and wears a harness, however he has been very reactive to dogs on walks in the past.

His current foster has really helped him become less reactive by redirecting his attention on walks with treats and going on longer walks. His future owners will need to continue this training.

Jakob gets on great with the children in his current foster home, however we will only rehome Jakob in an adult only home or with older dog savvy children.

Jakob currently lives with other dogs and could do so in his future home, however there would have to be multiple meets as he does not initially like other dogs.

Once he gets to know a dog he is fine, but he does need to be slowly and properly introduced. Jakob cannot be rehomed with cats. Jakob is toilet trained and sleeps well overnight.

He is not been crate trained. He can be left at home for a few hours and is not destructive. Jakob travels well in the car and his current foster is able to help with transport to his future home.

Jakob has no known health issues. He loves his little bone and bear toy (check him out in the photos!). Jakob is ready and waiting for the right home who can continue his training and help him live a happy, balanced life!

name: Frankie
description:
Frankie is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed and is small to medium in size. He can be nervous of new people he meets at first, however once settled he does enjoy their company. He has never shown any aggression.

Due to his anxieties he will need a quiet home who can continue building his confidence and ensure slow and sensible introductions with any visitors. Frankie accepts a collar, harness and lead.

Frankie is good on the lead and walks well, however he can pull on his way home—he will need continued work on this in his new home. Frankie is a bouncy, happy boy with a typical puppy temperament.

He can jump up and will bounce around trying to play with the other dogs or people in the home. Frankie will need an active family with a secure garden who can keep him busy with lots of long walks and mental stimulation.

Frankie has been around children 2+ in his current home and previously and he has done well with them. He can be boisterous and has knocked young children over when playing in the garden.

On one occasion he ran at a 6 year old when he had his back to him and this caused a scratch on his back. Frankie can therefore live with children 8+ following sensible introductions.

Frankie currently shares his home with another dog who he is very good with; he gains lots of confidence from him and has improved lots since being in this home.

Frankie may benefit from another confident dog in his new home to help build his confidence and show him the way. Frankie is very playful and will mouth while playing, another playful dog would be good for him.

He often tries to initiate play using his mouth, and air snaps in excitement. He does back off if told to by another dog, he whimpers and lays down. Frankie currently lives with a cat who he will mostly ignore, however he can chase if he moves suddenly, although he will stop when they give him a swipe.

He can therefore live with a confident, dog savvy cat with the ability to separate and provide slow and sensible introductions. He will need boundaries and continued work on his manners around the cats.

Frankie is toilet trained and uses a crate for travel; he doesn’t use it in the home. Frankie has never been destructive, however he does like to chew up his toys and de-stuff his teddies.

He can be left alone for long periods of time with no issues—he has been left up to 8 hours on one occasion. Frankie sleeps well overnight and will take himself off to his safe place for his bedtime biscuits after his last toilet in the garden.

Frankie has previously suffered with car sickness, however he does get in the car happily. The travel sickness has gotten much better.

name: Sultan
description:
Please meet Spirited Sultan! Sultan is a 2-year-old Bedlington Terrier. Sultan came to us following the arrival of a new baby. He struggled to adjust to this and, as a result, will need a home with teenage children or adults only.

True to their terrier type, Bedlington’s are “spirited and fierce” as they are very skilled hunters in the field and remain so when kept in a domestic environment.

One of the oldest purebred terriers ever, the Bedlington was originally bred in northern England, but by 1877 its reputation as an extremely capable hunter was spreading to other regions of the country.

These dogs may look like lambs, but they have the heart of a lion.

Sultan is very typical of the breed and will need an owner with experience with this breed. He can be a lovely little cuddle bug but when he gets bored or wants to hunt, he soon becomes a demon!!

Please do not be fooled by his cute fluffy coat; he is the definition of a wolf in sheep’s clothing, all 13kg of him.

Sultan is a real couch potato of a dog when he is indoors, a diva that will bark if he can’t get a space on the sofa or a dog in his favourite spot, he will tell you to come and sort it out!!

He is very obedient most of the time, but if he is allowed to get bored, he is also ignorant – so he needs a home that can exercise his legs and his brain!

He walks well on the lead and is pretty reliable off lead but I would never trust him in an open space, if he sees something dart he is off after it, this includes our chihuahuas!!

He would love a family to snuggle on the sofa with all day with the occasional break for walks and ball chasing, he loves this!

He is happy as the only dog or snuggled up with other dogs, but they need to be bigger than him or he can be a bully. He has never had to share his space.

He is house trained and non-destructive – happy to be left snoozing on the sofa, absolutely adores other dogs so could happily live with a companion but would equally be happy as the only dog.

Sultan is a gorgeous happy lad that so desperately needs a forever home and family of his own. Sultan is neutered, microchipped de flead and wormed and fully vaccinated, he travels well in the car.

name: Cleo
description:
Meet Cleo – Tiny in Size, Big in Personality!

Tiny | Confident | Friendly | Dog-friendly

Cleo is another one of our tiny little dots of a dog – but this little girl has a personality much bigger than her size! Cleo is a sweet, confident and friendly girl who really enjoys being around people.

She loves attention and is definitely a little more “me, me, me!” than some of our other tiny dogs! She likes to know that she is included and would love a home where she can be a very important part of the family.

She is great with other dogs and could live with a canine companion, but we think she may actually be happiest as an only dog where she doesn’t have to share all that attention.

If she does live with another dog, they would need to be friendly and non-dominant – Cleo certainly wouldn’t be suited to living with a dog who likes to boss her around!

Cleo hasn’t lived in a house before, so her new family will need to help her learn all about home life. She has been clean in her kennel, which is encouraging, but we can’t say yet that she is fully housetrained.

She will also need some support with her lead work and learning all the skills that come with being a much-loved pet.

And Cleo really is very, very small, so her new family will need to appreciate that although she may be tiny enough to pick up, she still needs to be treated as a dog and given the opportunity to explore, learn and enjoy life.

The Home Cleo Is Looking For Cleo could suit a variety of homes, provided her family understands her needs and is happy to give her the attention and guidance she deserves.

Alternatively, a friendly, non-dominant canine companion

A family who will enjoy having her involved in their lives

Patience and encouragement while she learns about house life

Someone willing to continue her lead work and training

A home where her tiny size is respected and she is treated like a dog, not a toy Cleo is a confident, friendly little character with so much to offer.

She may be tiny, but she certainly knows what she wants – and we think she is going to make someone a very special little companion.

Cleo is spayed, fully vaccinated and has a pet passport. Applicants must be prepared to travel to Ayr for a meet & greet and, if successful, collection.

name: Christia
description:
Christia is a two-year-old female Cross-Breed with a wonderful character.

She is looking for someone to help her leave the cage and find the loving home she deserves.

Christia is vaccinated, blood tested, spayed and microchipped.

She will be adopted with an adoption package and full rescue back-up. A home check applies.

If you can offer Christia a safe and loving forever home, please get in touch.

name: Bruno
description:
Bruno is approximately three years old and is ready to start looking for his forever family. Bruno is a friendly, active and affectionate boy who gets along well with other dogs and loves people.

He has a fun-loving personality, enjoys playtime, and would love a family who can give him plenty of exercise, attention and adventures. He has a lovely nature and is looking for a home where he can enjoy the love and security he deserves.

He is currently in Cyprus but can travel to the UK or Europe to the right home.

Bruno will be rehomed with a full adoption package, including:

VaccinationsMicrochipBlood testsNeuteringRescue back-up

If you think you could offer Bruno the loving forever home he is looking for, we’d love to hear from you.

name: Phoenix
description:
Phoenix is approximately 1.5 years old and is ready to find his forever home. He is a lovely, friendly boy who gets along well with people and other dogs. He has a wonderful character and would make a fantastic companion for the right family.

Phoenix will be adopted with a full adoption package, including:

VaccinatedMicrochippedBlood testedNeuteredRescue back-up and support

A home check and adoption application are required.

If you are interested in giving Phoenix the loving forever home he deserves, please send us a message.

name: Doralee
description:
Doralee came to us as a welfare case when her owner went abroad and left her and her family in the garden, She had 6 gorgeous pups and potentially dad with her, and these poor little guys had clearly not had much in the way of human input.

On arrival, she was scared and heavily matted, but it didn’t take her long to relax and then she absolutely craved love and attention.

Doralee was not chipped so we don’t know her age, but she is only a young adult no more than 2 years old, we don’t know her breed but our best guess is a Westie x poodle, now she has been shaved she definitely has a westie look to her.

Doralee is a wonderful cheeky dog, she is small and mighty and full of character and mischief!! Such a shame for such a gorgeous happy little lady to find herself homeless!

Doralee is a happy little lady that would love a family to play with her and keep her occupied, She loves a walk and loves to greet everyone she meets, and absolutely everyone that meets her very quickly falls in love!!

She is happy with other dogs so could live with another dog, or she would be equally happy as the only dog if her human is around a lot, she adores her people and is so responsive, she is a fantastic little girl!

Doralee can live with children 8 years plus, she is a lovely gentle girl, but does jump up to say hello so smaller children would not be suitable.

Doralee loves to run and loves to play with toys and a ball, she also loves galloping around with other dogs, she is an active girl that needs a home that can keep up with her energy.

She will also need a home that can commit to regular grooming as she doesn’t moult.

Doralee is non destructive, house trained and happy to be left for short periods. Doralee is a gorgeous happy, bouncy active little lady that so desperately needs a forever home and family to grow up with.

Doralee has been neutered, microchipped de flead and wormed.

name: Pongo
description:
The Sweetest Little Man Looking for His Forever Home

Pongo is one of those little dogs who will completely melt your heart.

Despite having a very unhappy start in life and not receiving the love and care he deserved from his previous owner, Pongo has come through it with the most beautiful, friendly nature.

When Pongo arrived with us, he was quite poorly, and our vets believe this was caused by a blockage. Thankfully, he has received the treatment he needed and is now very much on the mend.

He is eating happily, wagging his tail and showing us more and more of his lovely personality every day.

There are no lasting effects expected from his illness.

Pongo absolutely LOVES his people. He is an affectionate little chap who wants to be close to you, give you his paw and enjoy plenty of cuddles. He can become very attached to his people, so his ideal home will be one where he doesn’t have to compete for attention.

He is clean in the house, walks nicely on a lead and is simply the sweetest little man.

A home where he can receive plenty of love and attention

He can live as an only dog or with a non-dominant dog

He doesn’t need to be in a child-free home, but would prefer a family where he doesn’t have to compete for attention

A loving home where he can finally experience the security, affection and happiness he deserves Pongo has had a difficult beginning, but you really wouldn’t know it from the happy little dog he is becoming.

We want his next chapter to be very different — a home where he is cherished, included and truly feels like he belongs. Someone is going to be incredibly lucky to have this sweetest little man in their life.

Pongo is fully vaccinated, neutered and has a pet passport.

Pongo is currently in Ayr, Scotland. If you think Pongo could be the little man you’ve been looking for, please visit www.savingandrehomingstrays.org to find out more about our adoption process.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Applicants must be able to travel to Ayr for a meet and greet and, if successful, collection.

name: Oscar
description:
Fostered in Bulgaria – ready to travel to the United Kingdom

Oscar is a five-month-old male mixed breed puppy who is not only exceptionally beautiful, but also a truly special little dog. He is extremely intelligent, wonderfully social and has a fantastic personality that makes him stand out.

Oscar is great with dogs, cats and children and absolutely loves being around people. He is playful, affectionate and full of curiosity, always interested in what is happening around him and eager to be involved.

What makes Oscar particularly special is his intelligence and enthusiasm for learning. He already knows several commands and genuinely enjoys being taught new things.

He is focused, eager to please and loves the interaction that comes with training and learning. For someone who enjoys working with their dog, Oscar has exceptional potential.

He is the kind of puppy who could develop into an incredibly well-trained and rewarding companion with the right guidance, time and commitment.

He would thrive with people who want to do more than simply have a dog at home — people who will enjoy teaching him, keeping his clever mind occupied and building a strong bond with him.

Oscar is a beautiful, bright and wonderfully social young dog with so much to offer.

He is truly one of those puppies who leaves an impression, and we would love to see him find a family who will recognise just how special he is and give him the opportunity to reach his full potential.

name: Kancho
description:
Fostered in Bulgaria – ready to travel to the United Kingdom

Kancho is young male mixed breed weighing around 7kg. He is currently fostered in Bulgaria and is ready to travel to the United Kingdom.

He is neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, clinically healthy, and will travel with an EU pet passport and all required documentation.

Kancho is an absolute sweetheart with a loving and affectionate nature. He adores cuddles and being close to his people, making him a wonderful companion. He is fantastic with children and has a gentle, friendly temperament.

He enjoys the company of other dogs, especially those of a similar size, and currently lives happily with a Cocker Spaniel.

Kancho has excellent manners. He walks beautifully on the lead, travels calmly in the car, and behaves perfectly during grooming. He is an easy little dog to live with and would fit beautifully into many homes.

This charming little boy is looking for a forever family who will love him as much as he will love them. In return, Kancho will offer endless affection, loyalty, and companionship.

name: Mindy
description:
Fostered in Bulgaria – ready to travel to the United Kingdom

Mindy is a two-year-old female weighing approximately 6kg. She is currently fostered in Bulgaria and is ready to travel to the United Kingdom.

Mindy is fully vaccinated, microchipped, neutered, and in excellent health. She will travel with an EU pet passport and all the required documentation.

Mindy is an incredibly affectionate, loving, and people-oriented little dog.

She absolutely adores human company and is happiest when she is close to her family, whether that’s cuddling on the sofa, following you around the house, or simply enjoying your company.

She is the perfect companion dog for someone looking for a loyal little shadow.

She currently lives happily with five cats and is completely comfortable around them. She is also social with other dogs and has a gentle, friendly nature.

Mindy has excellent manners. She walks beautifully on the lead, is fully house-trained, and settles well indoors. She is an easy dog to live with and would fit effortlessly into many different homes.

If you are looking for a small dog with a huge heart, endless affection, and impeccable manners, Mindy could be the perfect addition to your family. She is ready to find the forever home she truly deserves.

name: Lora
description:
Fostered in Bulgaria – ready to travel to the United Kingdom

Lora is a three-year-old female mixed breed weighing around 20kg. She is a wonderfully social, calm and affectionate dog who is happy to be around everyone. Lora gets along beautifully with other dogs, cats and children.

She has a lovely, gentle temperament and is a very easy dog to live with. Lora enjoys human company and is always happy to receive attention and affection, while remaining calm and well-mannered.

She walks beautifully on the lead and has excellent house manners. She is fully vaccinated, spayed and ready to find her forever home.

Lora is a sweet, kind and peaceful girl who would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a well-adjusted and affectionate dog.

name: Zorro
description:
Zorro is a 7 year old male Shar-Pei cross Labrador Retriever.

He originally lacked confidence and he hadn’t walked much but his true character is showing now he has come out of his shell.

He has lived with cats, chickens, and guinea pigs and doesn’t seem to have any prey drive at all. He is reactive to other dogs, especially small energetic ones, so would need to be the only dog in the household.

Zorro is fit and healthy but his eyesight is not as good as what it should be in low-light situations. He loves a good cuddle with his human friends and is a pleasantly affectionate boy.

He really loves his long walks and would be best suited in an active home. Zorro could be rehomed in an adult only home.

He loves his food and treats which will make any further training that much easier and more fun.

name: Kim
description:
Kim is a 5-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a medium-sized dog who has been neutered and was rescued from a kill shelter over a year ago, alongside another dog named Cassie.

Kim is generally good with other dogs, although she can be a little nervous when meeting new people.

Her time in the kill shelter was clearly traumatic, and as a result, she needs time and patience to rebuild her trust in humans.

She hasn’t been tested with cats, so it’s uncertain how she would respond to them. Given her timid nature, she would be best suited to a quiet household without small children.

Kim has been neutered, fully vaccinated, and has had all the necessary blood tests completed.

She also has her own pet passport, which allows for safe and approved travel. She will be delivered directly to her adoptive home by a professional and authorised transport team.

Full rescue back-up (RBU) is provided to ensure her ongoing welfare. Kim is looking for a loving home that understands her need for calm and patience.

name: Zulu
description:
Zulu is a 4-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a friendly and sociable dog who enjoys the company of people and other dogs.

His affectionate nature makes him a wonderful companion, and he thrives in a home where he can interact and bond with both humans and canines alike.

Although Zulu is good with other dogs, he is a bit timid around cats. While he does not show aggression, he may need careful introductions and a patient approach when living with feline companions.

His social nature means he enjoys spending time with others, making him a great addition to a multi-dog household.

Zulu is also well-suited to living with children, provided they are aged 10 years or older. His temperament suggests he would do well in a family environment where children understand how to respect a dog’s space and needs.

He would appreciate a loving home that offers both companionship and structure.

Currently, Zulu is in foster kennels in Romania, waiting for his forever home. His background in foster care suggests he has had some experience with a home-like setting, though he may still need time to adjust once adopted.

With the right family, he will surely flourish and become a loyal and loving companion.

name: Tim
description:
Tim – A Gentle and Quiet Soul. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Arriving in UK on 13th June.

Meet TIM, about 2 years old, very friendly but little shy medium size boy. Despite his challenging start, TIM has grown into a calm and affectionate companion who is ready to share his quiet love with the right family.

Rescue Story:TIM’s life began on the outskirts of an industrial warehouse area, where he and his siblings struggled to survive as stray pups. Luckily, he was rescued as a puppy, but his time living in survival mode left him cautious and reserved.

Over time, TIM has learned to trust people and embrace the kindness of those around him, but he still faces the world with a touch of hesitation, needing patience and understanding to truly bloom.

Detailed Information:TIM is a calm and quiet dog who thrives in a peaceful environment. While he may be shy at first, once he feels safe, his loyalty and affection shine. He loves his walks, enjoys car rides, and is well-mannered on the lead.

Tim has a calm and gentle nature, making him a wonderful companion for a serene household.

He does best when paired with another dog, as their presence helps him feel more secure. He’s good with other dogs but needs a little time to adjust to new canine friends. With cats, TIM is largely indifferent indoors but might give chase outdoors if tempted.

While not aggressive, TIM is sensitive to loud noises and changes, so a quiet home without small children is ideal. He is house-trained for three walks a day and has never been left alone without the company of another dog, making him best suited for a family with an existing furry companion.

Ideal Family:TIM’s perfect home is one that values patience, understanding, and a calm lifestyle. He’d thrive in a household with another friendly dog to guide and comfort him. A family that enjoys walks, quiet companionship, and providing gentle encouragement will be the ideal match for Tim.

Health Information:TIM is fully healthy. Neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and treated for parasites. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before travel (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Rio
description:
Rio is a neutered male Cross-Breed of 18 months old.

As a pup, his front leg was damaged, and after two failed surgeries, it was amputated.

The decision was made to bring him to the UK, as he was too sweet and gentle to survive the streets of Romania. Now he is looking for his lifelong home.

Rio is good on the lead, fully house trained, immunised, microchipped, flea/wormed, and has a current passport.

He has been in training for six weeks, living with other dogs and children, but he is not suitable to live with cats.

Rio is a very good boy and will be the best member of any family.

name: Bailey
description:
Bailey is a 7 year-old male lurcher. He’s 25″ to the shoulder. (Mum was a greyhound x whippet, dad unknown)

Bailey was rehomed by Lurcher Link 5 years ago. Sadly his current owner is no-longer able to care for him and so he is looking for a new home.

Bailey is fine to be left home alone for reasonable amounts of time.

Bailey knows some commands : “sit”, “down”, “wait”, “look”, “come”.

Bailey has not had the exercise he needs recently due to his owner’s ill-health. Unfortunately this has meant that he has become reactive with other dogs and can be anxious at times – for example at the vets (due to the proximity of other dogs).

For this reason we think Bailey would be best rehomed somewhere where he will not meet many other dogs on his walks, while his new owners work on building his confidence and resolving this problem.

Bailey has previously lived with children.

name: Lennox
description:
Lennox is a 2 year old male Lurcher. He needs a new home. Lennox is one of the lucky ones, we had a space for him when his time was up at the stray pound. Lennox is 25-26″ to the shoulder. We don’t know anything about Lennox’s past because he was found as a stray.

When Lennox first arrived he was very anxious around strangers, especially men; however, over time he has become much more confident around people he knows, and only takes about 5 minutes or so to warm up to new people (he’s initially scared and backs away).

Lennox is not suitable to live with cats or other small furries, and we won’t rehome him with young children as we do not know what he will be like with them. Lennox may need housetraining – we do not know if he has ever lived in a house before.

Lennox is friendly with most other dogs and is very lively and playful with the right dog. He can be initially a bit selective with who he likes/dislikes, however. OVERALL LENNOX IS A NICE LAD WHO JUST NEEDS SOME TRAINING AND STABILITY IN HIS LIFE. He is neutered, microchipped and vaccinated. Lennox is at LURCHER LINK RESCUE, near Halifax, West Yorkshire.

name: Bim
description:
Meet Bim, a two-year-old neutered male originally from Cyprus.

Bim doesn’t have a disability, but he was living with his pack on a beach next to a busy main road. We are slowly finding homes for all the dogs that live on the beach, and we hope not too slowly.

In the summer, they are fairly safe because the tourists who attract them to the beach feed them, but at the end of the season, when the tourists are gone, the dogs start to cross the road looking for food.

This is the dangerous time for them, when they will be hurt or killed, so we need to find great homes now.

Bim lived on the beach with his mother and sister. His mother is adopted in Warrington, and now it is Bim’s turn to find a home.

Bim is very sweet and friendly. We believe he is a cross between a Labrador and a Pointer. He is a lover of the outdoors and would be a loving companion for a family with teenage children who want an active dog.

Bim is immunised, microchipped, and flea/wormed. He has a current Cypriot passport, so he can travel with his family.

Wolfies Legacy adoption donation applies, and a home check is required. Usually, your dog will join you within a week.

name: Victor
description:
Gentle is the word that we would first choose to describe this handsome Shepherd boy.

After being rescued, Victor was placed in private kennels for over 3 years sponsored by his rescuer. But life in kennels is not what a dog deserves, especially this sweet boy.

We are so happy that he’s with us now and we will make every effort to make sure that this lovely boy finds his happy ever after!

Victor is an absolute sweetheart! He’s affectionate and always up for a cuddle even with people that he’s only just met. We think that he’d be happiest as an only dog as he seems wary of other dogs.

Even though he was in kennels for so long, he wasn’t integrated with other dogs and it has left him a little fearful of them. Victor shows no aggression towards dogs, but he isn’t trusting of them.

Now that he’s relaxing into his new surroundings at the sanctuary, his playful side is coming out. He likes toys and will run after them and enjoys a game of tug. He walks well on a lead and we believe will be very responsive to positive reinforcement training.

We’re all in love with this gorgeous boy and think that he’s going to make a wonderful companion for someone. Homes with children over the age of 14 will be considered.

SPDC adoption package and homechecks apply.

name: Fraggle
description:
Fraggle is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed who is disabled; he’s never going to be winning a marathon or climbing a mountain, but he is a young dog with lots of mischief on his mind!

The perfect home for Fraggle will have at least one other dog to bomb around with – he is used to a whole pack and would enjoy a variety too.

He likes the attention of children, but his disability makes him clumsy and spatial awareness isn’t his speciality so he would knock a very small one over.

He can live with cats but if they are going to run away from him then he will make a game of chasing. A bold cat that will bop a nosey dog on the nose is fine.

A garden is essential for Fraggle. He does like to lie outside, as shepherds do and he isn’t physically capable of doing several long walks a day so he needs a nice garden to play in.

Fraggle is extremely friendly and affectionate with all people including groomers and vets.

Fraggle is 2 years old and we’ve spent several thousand pounds on his treatments and investigating his future prognosis.

We will not be abandoning him and we are happy to discuss foster-to-adopt and future security for possible big vet bills that won’t be covered by insurance.

We want Fraggle to have the same chance to be adopted as everyone else with financial assistance from us.

name: Varja
description:
Varja is a 3-year-old female Galga with a caramel coat, standing 60cm tall and weighing 20.8kg. She was rescued unexpectedly when she entered a trap cage meant for another dog.

When the person who had organised the rescue refused to take her, Galgos del Sur stepped in and took responsibility for her care. Varja arrived in the UK on 14 December 2024 and is currently in Essex.

She is neutered and in good health, although she has tested positive for Leishmaniasis, which is stable and well-managed with daily Allopurinol and a low purine diet.

She also has microphthalmia in one eye. Despite her difficult beginnings, Varja is a noble and sweet-natured dog who simply needs a quiet and safe environment where she can build trust and feel secure.

Varja is calm by nature but becomes scared in the presence of humans, particularly in unfamiliar situations. She requires a patient, experienced home with another confident, gentle dog who can help her feel at ease.

She is sociable and submissive with other dogs, showing no signs of dominance. While shy with strangers, she blossoms when given time and understanding.

Her favourite things include food, especially peanut butter, sleeping, and peaceful countryside walks. She has a few special talents—like appearing seemingly out of nowhere, being incredibly sweet, and showing brave resilience despite her fears. She is also cat workable, which adds to her suitability for the right home.

Varja’s ideal home would be in a quiet, rural area with a patient family and a resident dog to support her confidence. With kindness and time, Varja is sure to become a cherished companion.

name: Daphne
description:
Daphne is a young female lurcher (born Jan 2024). She is 24” to the shoulder and weighs 25kg. She has settled down well in her foster home in Falkirk, Scotland

Daphne loves other dogs and gets on well with the 3 other dogs in the foster home. She absolutely loves playing with them but is boisterous, and plays roughly and often noisily.

She has been slowly learning some manners around the other dogs and will respect the one dog who doesn’t want to play.

Daphne is excellent at meeting other dogs outside of the house. Daphne’s ideal home would be one where there is at least one other confident dog who would enjoy plenty of boisterous play.

Daphne loves all people and loves a cuddle; she’s very friendly . She gets very excited and will jump up at people (and lick them!); her foster carers are working on teaching her to keep all 4 paws on the floor instead.

She’s very bouncy and can still sometimes be a bit mouthy, so would not be suitable to live with young children.

Daphne currently pulls on the lead and is quite strong; her fosterers are working on improving her lead walking. Daphne needs a good off-lead run everyday in an enclosed secure field or large garden. She will need a secure garden with 6-foot fences.

Daphne is very eager to please and quick to learn, and is very food motivated. Daphne has been to a 1-2-1 flyball session, and she absolutely excelled – the trainer was so impressed with her and how quickly she picked it up.

She really enjoyed it and was so tired afterwards. An activity like flyball, scent work or agility where Daphne can use her brain and could channel her energy would suit her. Daphne also enjoys puzzle and search games in the garden.

Daphne is toilet trained and travels well in the car. Daphne sleeps right through the night.

Daphne does not like being left home alone for too long. She has been left successfully for a maximum of 1 hour in the company of other dogs.

This is something that can be worked on, and the time spent left home alone should be able to be built up once she has fully settled into a new home (this cannot be rushed).

Ideally a home with at least one other confident dog would be best, to provide her with support and company when left home alone.

Daphne can be possessive over food and toys; she will growl at the other dogs and try to steal all the toys. Therefore her fosterers have been carefully supervising any playtimes with toys and she is being fed separately from the other dogs.

The fosterers think that Daphne resource guards due to insecurities and lack of confidence.

She has not lived with other dogs before but has made some progress in her foster home – with sensible guidance it’s likely she will continue to slowly improve.

Daphne cannot be rehomed around sheep (due to an unfortunate incident with her previous owner), and must be kept on-lead when walked in areas with livestock.

Daphne’s ideal forever home is one where there is at least one other confident dog to help her with her separation anxiety and has similar energy levels and would enjoy lots of playtime; but who is also tolerant of her resource guarding.

Alternatively she could be rehomed as an only dog (so the resource guarding wouldn’t be an issue), but she’d need a lot more exercise and mental stimulation and the separation anxiety would be more challenging to improve.

name: JiJi
description:
JiJi is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She has travelled from N.Macedonia for a new and safe life. She was hit by a car at just six months, she suffered from a fractured pelvis. This is now healed but there are signs of historic injury in her gait.

JiJi has lived with other dogs, is tolerant of cats and after initial nervousness adores her keeper.

Jiji is having to grow up fast in an unsympathetic country that doesn’t allow a puppy time to be just that, hence the move to the UK.

Stunningly beautiful, Jiji will win hearts with her good looks. She is immunised microchipped flea/wormed and spayed. She has travelled on a current passport.

name: Maia
description:
Maia is a 1 year 3 month old female Spanish Mastin Cross who was found as a puppy, with her mother and siblings, and taken into rescue.

One year later and she’s still in kennels, constantly overlooked in favour of fluffier and “cuter” dogs.

Since Maia has spent most of her life in kennels, she hasn’t seen much of the world.

As a result, she’s shy around strangers, but bribe her with some treats and she’ll soon be asking for belly rubs!

Maia’s mum is a small Mastin, and Maia has inherited the Mastin ‘look’ and typical calm/gentle nature.

She’s much smaller than a Mastin though – she’s currently only just over 30kg.

Maia is currently in kennels with her sister, Tootsie. The two get on incredibly well – they spend a lot of time alone together and don’t ask for much.

It would be amazing if they could be adopted together, but they can also be homed separately.

They are currently in Spain but can travel to the UK/EU.

Please get in touch if you’re interested in adopting Maia (or Maia and Tootsie together!).

name: Missy
description:
Missy is a 9 year old female Akita. She came to us because she was a sad and underweight girl.

Missy was lucky and found herself a fabulous foster home to wait in until she finds her new forever family and she has blossomed, she is now a healthy weight which her carers are maintaining.

Missy has a fabulous personality, she loves her food and will become vocal if her after-breakfast treat of a toothbrush chew doesn’t arrive on time or is forgotten!

Missy loves her toys and has her toy box, she meets her foster family with her favourite in her mouth when they return home, and then it is time to play.

Missy is very bright and knows what is hers, even if this is a newly purchased toy, taking it from your hand or bag, she enjoys finding treats in her puzzle balls and snuffle mat.

Missy has not been destructive when left on her own and will only chew on her toys and chew treats. She is a very clean girl and there have been no accidents in the house.

Missy knows how to let you know that she wants something. She is a very loving girl who is happy to curl up in the evening and watch TV.

Missy knows it is bedtime and will take herself off to bed with a toy she has carefully chosen. Missy is very active and will need a few decent walks each day.

Her foster carers are working on her reaction to other dogs which can vary between nervous and reactive.

Missy is looking for a home where there are no other dogs and she cannot be rehomed with cats. She travels very well in the car and does enjoy adventure.

Missy has proven to be very much a man’s dog, she loves them both but much prefers the company of her foster Dad to her foster Mum.

Missy can live with children over the age of 12 years of age. If you have a lot of love to give and would like to offer Missy her forever home we would love to hear from you so please get in touch. She is currently fostered in Northumberland.

name: Iza
description:
Iza is an 11 year old female Cross-Breed. She must live in a dog and pet-free home. Before coming to our rescue Iza had spent her entire life living in a shelter.

She had been rescued as a puppy (along with her brother) by a well-meaning rescuer, but 8 years later was still sitting in a pen having never known much social interaction.

As a result, she arrived with us as a very timid little thing.

Over time her confidence has grown and she is now an absolute delight.

She loves a good fuss and cuddle and despite being much smaller than her brother, she definitely is the boss out of the two.

She is a friendly lady and is happy with new people pretty quickly after being introduced and she really loves to snuggle.

She will need work on lead training so her family will need a secure home and garden to begin her training. If you can offer her love, comfort, and patience we would really like to hear from you.

name: Meghan
description:
Meghan is a 2 year old female Spanish Mastin.

Meghan was first taken into rescue at 6 months old, when she was found wandering the streets of Spain on her own. She was adopted in the UK and was raised as a pet for the next year.

However, due to the intensity of her character and her propensity to guard, she ended up back in foster – this time, on a farm that has working livestock guardian Mastins.

It was quickly evident that those same instincts that made her a handful as an adolescent pet could be molded into the traits that make up an amazing livestock guardian dog.

Now, 8 months and a lot of training later, Meghan is a tried-and-tested working livestock guardian dog with an impressive set of skills. She has been trained with poultry – chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese.

She naturally protects against both land predators (foxes, badgers, otters, and more) and aerial predators (in our case, magpies, crows, and buzzards) – basically, anything that shouldn’t be in, near, or above her boundaries will be chased away. This includes mice/rats – a very useful skill for a poultry guardian dog to have!

Through a fence, after being properly introduced, Meghan is friendly with male dogs. She will happily interact with male dogs when on a lead too but shouldn’t be off-lead with them.

She’s prone to resource guarding random things from them, which can lead to a fight. Like many female LGDs, Meghan doesn’t like female dogs. She will mostly ignore them from a distance but makes a lot of noise if they approach her fence line.

Meghan isn’t 100% trustworthy around cats. It’s best that she doesn’t have direct access to them, but can coexist with them on the same smallholding. The 2 cats she currently lives with choose to stay away from her.

With people, Meghan is extremely friendly and sociable. She is gentle and sweet with children too. She loves being the centre of attention but also always has one eye on her surroundings – she will quickly abandon a cuddle if she spots something that needs to be investigated further!

Meghan is a very independent and intelligent dog. She needs an adopter who understands how sensitive yet stubborn livestock guardian breeds can be. The two of you will need to be a team, so the focus at the beginning needs to be on bonding.

She isn’t a machine that’s going to immediately start working for you on day one, but once she has a solid connection with you, she would give her life for you/your animals. She is an amazing protector of her boundaries.

Meghan is currently in foster in Aberdeenshire, Scotland. We’re hoping to find her a local-ish home, so that we can do a gradual transition. However, if you live further afield but have the perfect home for her, we would consider that too.

name: Stormzie
description:
Meet Stormzie, an 18 month old male Rough Coat Lurcher who is truly special.

Stormzie had a rough life before coming to us and was on the run for over a week before being trapped and rescued.

It has taken a long time for him to trust his foster parents, as he is nervous around new people and remains a timid, scared boy.

Stormzie is house trained and loves all the dogs he has met, often doing amazing zoomies in the garden.

His best friend is Bramble, and they play and run around the garden like overgrown puppies.

His forever home must be prepared to do several meet and greets at the foster home.

The ideal home will need a fully fenced garden and someone who can be around often.

Stormzie cannot live with cats, and the home should have children aged 14 years and older.

name: Bravo
description:
He is a Romanian mioritic (mio) cross. He is four years old and currently in foster in Essex.

Bravo is excelling in the care of his fosterers, he’s now just waiting for the perfect forever family to come along and fall in love with him too!

Bravo is more suited to someone who knows about the typical mioritic traits. He has been tested around livestock, he’s not a fan of horses, but sheep he does not seem to mind.

He is a rather large boy! 37kg! A strong handler would be better suited for bravo. He is not a fan of cats or children I’m afraid! Bravo doesn’t mind being the only dog in the home but he wouldn’t mind a nice calm dog, that would happily leave him to it.

Bravo bonds tightly with his people so a careful and slow paced introduction to his new humans will have to happen.

When bravo does bond with his people though it is done very strongly and he loves cuddles! He is neutered and vaccinated and has been health checked.

name: Reggie
description:
Reggie is a 3-year-old Bull-Lurcher, a delightful young lad brimming with joy and playfulness.

Standing at 25″ to the shoulder and weighing around 26kg, Reggie is an intelligent and trainable companion. His repertoire of tricks includes sit, paw, high 5, and wait, showcasing his sharp mind and eagerness to please.

Affectionate and fond of cuddles, Reggie is excellent with people and enjoys engaging with his favorite toys, particularly balls.

While Reggie can display initial exuberance on the lead, he typically settles down during walks.

Unfortunately, his previous owner had to relinquish him to Lurcher Link Rescue due to the demands of a full-time job, leading to separation anxiety issues.

In a foster home, Reggie’s separation anxiety improved with careful handling, but he still requires an understanding owner willing to gradually build up his tolerance to being left alone.

Consequently, he wouldn’t be well-suited to prolonged periods of solitude.

Reggie is compatible with other dogs during walks, but it’s advised that he does not share a home with another canine companion.

Neutered, microchipped, and vaccinated, Reggie is currently residing at Lurcher Link Rescue near Halifax, West Yorkshire.

Please note that a home check and adoption fee are applicable.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 5 year old male Labrador Retriever Cross.

Lovable Lenny is a big goofball who has so much love to give, we are pretty sure that his heart is just as big as he is!

He’s a giddy, animated boy who loves to play with toys.

He is not one for sharing but enjoys a game of fetch, be careful on the way back though as he has no brakes!

Once he has had a good run Lenny is a real couch potato who he enjoys his own space.

We often find him snoozing on a lounger in the sun or lazing about in his bed.

Lenny can be unsure of strangers and will require slow, sensible introductions.

He can react defensively if he is unsure about a situation or feels threatened.

He will need an experienced and confident owner who is familiar with handling reactive dogs, someone who can read his signals and keep him safe.

We are looking for an adult only home for Lenny, without visiting children. He could be left alone for several hours as he is clean and non destructive.

Lenny is a bright boy and loves food which makes training a breeze.

He needs stability and routine, once he knows what is expected of him he is very well mannered and compliant.

Lenny is selective with other dogs and prefers the ladies, however we do feel he would be best suited to being the only dog in the home. He cannot live with cats.

He is extremely bright, wants to learn, has no idea of his size, weight or what is acceptable behaviour at the moment. Because he gets excited very quickly, he can also become frustrated very quickly so any training that is to be done with Lenny needs to be very short, with plenty of reinforcement of the good elements we want to encourage.

Lenny wants to do the right things, but is confused sometimes. So calm, confident and very clear work is to be done to help him move forwards.

If he gets confused he can jump up so it is really important you are calm around him. We would then advise that to encourage a sit/wait and reward it. He is not able to cope with ‘no’ or negative interactions at all.

It appears that Lenny struggles to relax and calm his mental ability down to think rationally. This is another reason why any interactions need to be short at the beginning. Short and regular is going to help Lenny develop more concentration, less questioning and confusion, and in turn proper self confidence.

Lenny wants to do the right thing and is eager to please. However, if the timing is not right then frustration can easily take over. He is also developing the stabilising part of his brain at the moment and that is why he can handle some interactions, but not lots of stimulus.

He needs to go to a home with space, a large garden, calm large breed experienced owners who will be willing to help him learn and make the right life choices.

Lenny is truly is one of the forgotten ones, one of ‘the dogs that no one wants’ and it breaks our hearts as he is the most beautiful boy.

We are hoping that someone with the right knowledge and skills can see the potential in this black beauty.

Part/full time foster homes will also be considered for Lenny.

name: Bobby
description:
Bobby is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a friendly and resilient dog who, despite being a tripaw, enjoys going out for walks and exploring at his own pace.

While he is not overly energetic, Bobby still appreciates regular outings and would enjoy being part of an active, yet relaxed, household.

He is good with other dogs and previously lived with a female Lurcher, suggesting he could be a good companion in a multi-dog home.

Bobby is also suitable to live with children over eight years old, mainly due to his strength. His nature is gentle, and he thrives with human companionship.

Bobby’s journey has been difficult. He was adopted by a loving owner, but sadly lost his home again when his adopter passed away just six months later.

Now in rescue in North Wales, Bobby is ready for another chance at finding a permanent, loving home. He is neutered, immunised, microchipped, and has been treated for fleas and worms.

Bobby would be an ideal companion for someone looking for a loyal, steady friend. He deserves a home where he can be loved and feel secure, especially after all he has been through.

name: Mojo
description:
Handsome Mojo is a 3-year-old male dog currently residing in a Romanian private shelter. He was rescued from a distressing kill shelter and has undergone rehabilitation at the CHR Pet Rescue Centre.

This gorgeous boy is now prepared to make his way to the UK in search of a loving home.

Mojo, a 27kg neutered dog, has been fully vaccinated and undergone blood testing, including screening for brucella. Despite his challenging past, Mojo has proven to be an affectionate companion, showing a deep appreciation for his caregivers.

Prospective families interested in welcoming Mojo should be active, committing to providing him with two daily walks and engaging in mental stimulation activities. In return, they can expect to be rewarded with the companionship of an amazing dog.

It’s important to note that Mojo is compatible with another active female neutered dog, but he is not suitable for households with cats. Additionally, Mojo thrives in the company of older children, making him an ideal companion for families with kids aged 7 and above.

For those considering adopting this wonderful dog, the Pennypaws rescue team offers full support. As a registered charity with the number 1200959, Pennypaws is dedicated to ensuring that Mojo finds a caring and responsible forever home.

If you are ready for the rewarding experience of welcoming Mojo into your family, please consider providing a loving home for this handsome boy.

name: Travis
description:
Travis is a 6 year old male German Shepherd Cross. He is from Romania born on the 30 Oct 2017 and came into rescue along with his 2 siblings and has not been rehomed with them yet due to his disability.

Travis has been with us in the UK since May 2018 and now we would love to find a very special home for this very special boy.

Travis was born with issues in his hips and the many vets in Romania diagnosed many different things but it was only when he came into our care and saw our vets (and had more X-Rays) that we confirmed a diagnosis. Travis does not have any hip sockets – they never formed.

So his hips do not stay in place and move about which he moves. He has never needed any pain relief and is a strong dog and copes very well and isn’t in any pain.

Initially, our vets said he should be PTS but after seeing him playing very happily, in no pain and with the strength that he has in his front end he agreed he has a great quality of life and deserves a chance to live it to the full.

Travis loves running around the garden and playing so needs a nice big garden and lots of space.

We do need his home to have an understanding vet who is willing to work with us if necessary for any decisions on his future treatment and this would be part of our adoption contract. Fabulous with other dogs especially boy dogs.

Travis can be funny with new people and can be a bit barky. It doesn’t take him long to warm up and we think it’s a bit of territory guarding as he is fine when out and about.

Travis walks fine on a lead and travels well in the car and has been well-behaved at the groomers.

Travis would be perfectly happy in a home where he never goes for a walk as long as he has a big garden to run around and people to give him love and attention.

Travis is a very sweet soul. If you can offer Travis the extra special home and family he needs we would like to hear from you.

name: Max
description:
Max – 5 year old male Whippet x Terrier mix is about 23 inches to the shoulder. He was adopted from Lurcher Link two years ago but has come back due to his owner’s declining health.

Max is now sharing his kennel with Dolly. They love playing together, and Max is actually pretty tolerant of the very exuberant Dolly! We think he would be best rehomed with a steady female dog.

Max can be a little nervous around strange dogs and may bark, but he’s fine with other dogs once he gets to know them. He was a bit nervous with strange people when he first arrived back at the kennels, but he’s absolutely fine with everyone here now, including all the volunteer dog walkers.

Max is anxious about being left home alone and can be quite vocal. He will need to be adopted where he is only left for short periods (at least to start with) while his separation anxiety is worked on.

Not suitable to live with cats or young children.

Max is at Lurcher Link Rescue, near Halifax, West Yorkshire.

Homecheck and adoption fee will apply. More details about Max can be found on the Lurcher Link Rescue forum.

name: Mozze
description:
Mozze is a 2-year-old male cross-breed dog, currently in foster in Oxfordshire, UK.

He’s a firm favourite among the staff at Perrera Dogs UK.

Despite spending the last two years at the shelter due to his hip dysplasia, Mozze is a stunning and friendly boy who deserves a loving home.

He is dog, cat, and child-friendly (ages 10+), although he is nervous around men.

The charity has agreed to cover the cost of his necessary hip surgery, but potential adopters will need to be assessed for their suitability for his lengthy recovery period post-surgery.

Mozze is of medium size, fully vaccinated, and has undergone a health check.

name: Bullet
description:
Bullet is a young male bull lurcher; about 15 months old and 27″ to the shoulder.

Bullet is fine with children (but too boisterous to be rehomed with very young kids because he might knock them over).

Toilet trained. (but currently in kennels, so may need to readjust to being in a home again)

Bullet is being trained to walk nicely on a lead – currently he pulls quite strongly.

Any new owner will need to be prepared to continue with this training.

Bullet shows some signs of distress at being left so will need patient new owners who are around for much of the time (at least to start with); and who are prepared take time to build up how long he is left home alone.

Bullet is at LURCHER LINK RESCUE, near Halifax, West Yorkshire.

name: Tessa and Tosca
description:
Tessa and Tosca are 5 year old female Cross-Breeds. They must live in a child-free, pet-free, and dog-free home and would ideally be rehomed together. Tessa and Tosca were in a shelter together for 3 years before coming under our care.

During that time they were well cared for but did not receive as much human attention as they perhaps needed. As a result, they came to us as very timid pups and have both been adopted separately and come back to us as they were too timid apart to live in a home.

We would therefore love to see these girls adopted together as they rely on each other for their confidence.

At the rescue they enjoy playing, sleeping, and cuddling.

Tessa and Tosca have done a little lead training at the rescue, but we would need a family willing to put in the time and effort to gain their trust and work on their training slowly and with our support.

We know it’s a big ask to find these two a home together, but we like to dream big for our dogs.

name: Ben
description:
Welcome Ben, a gentle 7 year old male Cross-Breed with a heart full of potential.

Ben is a medium-sized boy (just 18kg) who’s looking for an understanding and experienced owner who can offer him the peace and patience he needs to thrive.

Rescued just in time from a kill shelter, Ben has already been through so much.

Despite his difficult past, he’s made incredible progress during his rehabilitation at CHR, and he’s now ready to take the next step in his journey to happiness.

Ben would thrive in a quiet, calm home with no children, where he can feel safe and secure.

While he’s been temperamental in the past, he’s shown that with patience and care, he can open up to people and build trust.

He’s also comfortable living with a calm female dog who shares his gentle energy.

Ben’s reactivity comes from his past experiences, but at just 18kg, he’s a manageable size for someone with experience.

With a calm, understanding owner, Ben has the potential to become a devoted and loving companion. He simply needs someone to believe in him and give him the chance he’s been waiting for.

Male, approximately 7 years old • Medium size, 18kg • Currently in Romania but ready to travel • Fully blood-tested, vaccinated, and neutered • Full RBU and support from Pennypaws Rescue and a homecheck is required

Ben is a quiet, soulful boy who just needs the right home to flourish. Could you be the one to show him what love and security feel like?

Ben has already come so far—now he just needs someone to help him find his happily ever after. Could you be his perfect match?

name: Lila
description:
Lila is a 4-year-old female Shepherd Cross. She’s a gentle, soulful girl with a calm and steady heart, now under the care of Azil Danica through the Network for Animals in Bosnia.

At 29 kilograms and 53 centimetres tall, she’s a medium-sized beauty with a quiet, graceful presence that instantly brings peace to those around her.

Lila has an incredibly even temperament — she never reacts to other dogs or cats and is wonderfully patient and calm around children. Her gentle nature and soft heart make her an ideal companion for anyone looking for a loyal, peaceful friend to share their life with.

Life hasn’t always been kind to Lila. She came from a harsh old shelter where survival was all she knew, and sadly, she’s spent much of her life being overlooked. Despite everything, she’s remained grateful, kind, and quietly hopeful for a chance at real love.

There’s something special about dogs like Lila — the ones who don’t demand attention but win your heart with their quiet strength.

She may not be the flashy, outgoing type, but she’s full of warmth and steady devotion. She’s ready for someone who will finally see her for the extraordinary dog she is.

Lila is fully vaccinated, blood tested, spayed, microchipped, and treated for fleas and worms. She’s also been ELISA brucellosis lab tested, so her adopters can have full confidence in her health.

She’s searching for a kind, understanding home that values her gentle soul. Lila would do beautifully in a calm environment where her loving nature can truly shine.

Rescue support and backup are available in the UK, and home checks and adoption applications apply.

This lovely girl has waited long enough — now it’s time for her to be noticed and cherished for the wonderful companion she’s always been.

name: Zena
description:
Zena is a 9 month old female large and lean Cross-Breed currently with Forget Me Not Reading Rescues.

Zena is our absolutely stunning girl who captures hearts everywhere she goes. With her sleek, jet-black coat that shimmers in the light and those soulful, intelligent eyes, she’s as beautiful on the outside as she is inside.

Her expressive face and elegant build make her truly striking — she’s a head-turner who stands out for all the right reasons.

Zena isn’t just a pretty face, though. She’s full of playful puppy energy and has a wonderful zest for life. Whether she’s bounding through the grass, exploring new smells, or leaning in for cuddles, she does everything with pure enthusiasm.

She loves people and thrives on human company, soaking up affection and attention wherever she can.

Zena is also great with other dogs and enjoys socialising, so she could happily live alongside another friendly, confident dog after successful introductions.

She’s still a youngster and learning her way in the world, so she’ll need ongoing positive training, gentle guidance, and consistency as she matures — but she’s a bright, eager girl who’s keen to please.

She travels well once settled, enjoys her walks, and loves spending time with those she trusts. A home that can offer her both mental and physical stimulation will bring out her very best.

• Regular walks, play, and adventures• Continued training and positive reinforcement• A secure garden to zoom around and relax in• Plenty of love and reassurance as she grows in confidence

She could live with older, sensible children who understand she’s still learning and respect her space when she needs it.

Zena’s combination of beauty, brains, and boundless love makes her an absolute gem. She has so much potential to blossom into a loyal, affectionate companion for a family who can match her energy and give her the time and patience she deserves.

Zena — sleek, shiny, and stunning inside and out. Ready to bring joy, laughter, and love to her forever home.

name: Kiera
description:
Kiera is a 2½ year old female Bulldog Cross currently located in Berkshire and searching for her forever home.

Meet Kiera, our stunning Bulldog Cross with the softest eyes and the biggest heart. At just 2½ years old, Kiera has already experienced more than most dogs her age — but she’s taken it all in her stride with her trademark smile and a tail that never stops wagging.

Kiera is one of those dogs who wins you over instantly. She’s loving, gentle, and incredibly people-focused — happiest when she’s near her humans, whether that’s playing outside, snoozing at your feet, or rolling over for belly rubs. She thrives on affection and gives it right back tenfold.

She’s brilliant with children and adores being part of family life. Despite her strong build, Kiera has a soft, calm temperament and responds beautifully to reassurance and gentle handling.

She loves fuss, cuddles, and simply being included. Kiera has an outstanding temperament and is happy just to curl up on a comfy sofa — being next to her human is enough for her.

Kiera has come such a long way since arriving with us. She’s fully vaccinated, microchipped, and doing really well on lead walks.

She’s curious about the world, loves exploring new smells, and enjoys meeting friendly people and dogs on her walks. Kiera is not a high-energy dog — 30-minute walks twice a day are ample exercise for her.

She’s currently around 35 kg — a healthy girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. Kiera rides nicely in the crate in the car, settles well after walks, and has shown no issues around food or other dogs.

Kiera would thrive in a loving, stable home where she can finally relax and feel part of the family. She’d suit:

• A home where someone is around most of the day (she loves company).• Families with children, or adults who enjoy active, affectionate dogs.• Possibly living with another calm, well-balanced dog (subject to introductions).

She’s happiest when she has routine, gentle guidance, and time to unwind. Once she trusts you — which doesn’t take long — she’ll be your loyal shadow and best friend.

From her foster carer:“Kiera is just the sweetest girl. She loves to sit with you and has the funniest little grin when she’s happy. She’s got so much love to give — she deserves a home that will adore her for the rest of her life.”

Kiera is ready to start her next chapter — one filled with warmth, safety, and love. If you think you could offer her the home she deserves, please reach out.

name: Chupka
description:
Chupka is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed currently under the care of Azil Danica (Network for Animals in Bosnia).

Her name means “Fluffy” — and that is exactly what she is. The softest little cloud with a heart full of sunshine.

Chupka is playful, cheerful, and always open to new people and experiences. She walks beautifully on the lead, loves every dog she meets, and pays no attention to cats.

She is the kind of dog that makes every day brighter — a happy soul ready to share her joy with someone who will finally call her their own.

Application and home check apply.Rescue support and backup in the UK via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Islay
description:
Islay is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed.

Fostered in Ayr, ScotlandDOB: 28 December 2024Vaccinated, pet passport ready, not yet spayed (too young)

Islay was rescued in Romania as a tiny pup with her 2 sisters and grew up in cramped rescue kennels without much space to run or play. But now she’s here in Scotland, she’s making up for every missed moment — and she’s doing it with gusto!

The joker of the trio, Islay has absolutely no spatial awareness and barrels through life with oversized enthusiasm. She hasn’t lived in a home or walked on a lead before, so her new family will need patience, commitment, and a good sense of humour.

She’s a big puppy with even bigger energy, so an adult-only home with a large, secure garden is essential — ideally in a rural area where she can zoom to her heart’s content.

Islay may be a big girl but she’s pure joy wrapped in fur and will reward her family with endless laughs and love.

All three sisters are gentle, sweet, and eager to love. They need dedicated homes willing to guide them through the basics of home life, but the reward will be three incredible companions with hearts as big as their paws.

Think you could give one of these girls their forever home?

name: Iona
description:
Iona is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed.

Fostered in Ayr, ScotlandDOB: 28 December 2024Vaccinated, pet passport ready, not yet spayed (too young)

Iona’s story began in Romania, where she was rescued as a tiny puppy with her 2 sisters. Sadly, she spent her whole puppyhood in rescue kennels with not much space or adventure.

Despite this tough start, Iona has grown into a gentle, friendly girl with so much love to give.

She can be a little shy when she first meets new people, but she warms up quickly and soon becomes your number-one fan. Like her sisters, Iona has never lived in a home or walked on a lead, so she’ll need patient owners willing to teach her everything from scratch.

She’ll thrive in an adult-only, rural home with a secure garden, where she can stretch her legs and build her confidence at her own pace. Sweet, beautiful, and playful — Iona just needs her chance to shine.

All three sisters are gentle, sweet, and eager to love. They need dedicated homes willing to guide them through the basics of home life, but the reward will be three incredible companions with hearts as big as their paws.

Think you could give one of these girls their forever home? Apply now at www.savingandrehomingstrays.org

name: Lottie and Lucy
description:
Lottie and Lucy are 15 month old female Labrador Retriever Crosses.

These beautiful sisters were found in a field in Romania when they were tiny.

They are very friendly, lively, and medium-sized. They love to move around, but currently, they only have a kennel to run around in.

They are bored and really need a proper life now, as they don’t get out at all.

It would be lovely if they could be homed together, but it’s not essential. They need adopters who have plenty of time for them and can offer a fun and interesting life.

They are vaccinated, microchipped, and will have the Brucellosis test.

The adoption fee is £475, which includes transport to your home.

A home check is required, and there is rescue backup.

name: Lucho
description:
Lucho is a 5-year-old male Sabueso Hound. He was born on 28/04/2020 and has found himself in the shelter because he isn’t suited for hunting.

Despite this, Lucho has a lot of qualities that make him a wonderful family companion, and he is simply waiting for the right home to come along.

Lucho weighs 20.2kg, stands at 54cm tall, and is 94cm long, making him a medium-sized dog. He is described as super sweet, although he can be a little shy when meeting new people.

Once he feels secure, his true nature shines through, and he becomes affectionate and loving with those he trusts.

Obedience is one of Lucho’s strong points, and with the right environment, he will quickly settle into family life. He has the makings of an incredibly loyal and devoted pet, eager to share his love with a household that appreciates him.

Full rescue back up is provided, ensuring that support is available to both Lucho and his adopters.

attributes.Breed: Dogue de bordeaux cross labrador retriever

name: Benji
description:
Currently in our kennels in Lancashire but our rescue is in the Reading area. Viewings take place in Lancashire kennels and travel will be funded by us.

Benji is a handsome, happy, and bouncy 16-month-old Dogue de Bordeaux x Labrador looking for an active, loving family to call his own.

This big softie is bursting with personality and adores spending time with his favourite people. He is incredibly affectionate and just wants to be part of the family.

Sadly, Benji has had a very unsettled start to life. In his first year, he was passed around between three different families, bonding with each of them before being moved on again.
