His last family made the heartbreaking decision to have him euthanised simply because he had grown too big — something we could not let happen. Benji deserves stability, security, and the chance to finally put down roots with a family who will love him forever.

Despite his rocky start, Benji is a resilient and joyful boy. He is very intelligent, loves learning, and responds brilliantly to training. He thrives when given structure and guidance.

He enjoys enrichment games, sniff and search games, and playing with his ball— it’s one of his absolute favourite activities!

As a young, energetic dog, Benji needs a family who can give him regular exercise, long walks, and plenty of mental stimulation. He is best suited to an active home where he won’t be left alone for long periods and can be involved in daily life.

Benji is great with people and loves meeting new friends. He would do best living with a friendly, calm female dog who can be a positive role model.

He is not suitable to live with cats and will need a home with older, dog-savvy children who are confident around large, bouncy dogs.

This gorgeous boy is currently based in Reading, but potential adopters will need to travel to Lancashire to meet him. Don’t worry — we will fully fund travel costs so you can focus on getting to know him.

Benji’s Ideal Home would be with an active family. He enjoys long walks, playtime, and training.

He would love someone experienced with large breeds who can continue his training. He would benefit from a home with a calm female dog (preferred)

Benji is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and will leave with full rescue back-up for life. You’ll never be alone in supporting him — we’re here to help every step of the way.

Benji is a very special dog with so much love and potential. After being let down so many times, he deserves a forever home where he can finally feel safe and secure.

name: Hank
description:
Hank – 3 year old male Anatolian Shepherd Cross-Breed

Hank is a beautiful rescue boy from Cyprus, currently in the Atherstone, West Midlands area and now looking for his forever home. He’s around 37kg, house and crate trained, and travels well in the car.

Hank loves his walks, is good on the lead, and enjoys the company of other dogs. Ideally, he would suit a home where he is an only dog or with a friendly older female dog to show him the ropes and boost his confidence.

He lives alongside a cat currently — while he may chase if the cat runs, he’s happy to coexist peacefully when the cat stays calm.

Hank is a real gentle soul once he bonds with you. He would suit an experienced home with older, dog-savvy children simply due to his size and strength. He has been great in his former home with the young children there.

A secure, safe garden to play and relax in

A quieter environment without too much coming and going

If you think you could be Hank’s perfect match, please get in touch. When contacting us, it would help greatly if you could include:

Information about other pets or dogs in your home

How long Hank would be left alone each day

Minimum adoption donation of £300 applies. Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, and agreement to our post-adoption policies.

Let’s find Hank the home he truly deserves!

name: Jamie
description:
Jamie is a 5 month old male Cross-Breed puppy currently based in Cyprus, patiently waiting in kennels for his forever family.

Sweet, baby Jamie is still waiting patiently in our kennels in Cyprus, dreaming of the day his forever family finds him. Despite being overlooked time and time again, we know the right person is out there – someone who will see just how special he truly is.

Jamie is one of the “8 puppies with no mom” – a litter born in heartbreaking circumstances at the beginning of January 2025, with no mother to guide them. But from day one, Jamie has shown incredible strength, resilience, and heart.

Thanks to dedicated care and love, Jamie has grown into a healthy, happy, and wonderfully social pup. He’s playful, affectionate, and already showing signs of becoming the kind of loyal companion families dream of. Jamie is expected to be medium-sized when fully grown – the perfect fit for cuddles on the couch and adventures in the garden.

He’s more than just a puppy – he’s a little survivor, full of love and hope. Now all Jamie needs is someone to believe in him and give him the happiest of endings.

Could you be the one to give Jamie the love he’s been waiting for?

Before travelling to the UK, Jamie will receive a full veterinary check, vaccinations, microchipping, and have his passport prepared.

£155 to reserve Jamie – this allows us to begin his vaccinations and prepare his travel documents.

£385 once his flight is confirmed – this covers transport to the UK.

Our team handles every step of the process to bring Jamie safely home to you. Adopting from abroad is simpler than you may expect – and incredibly rewarding! We’re here to support you throughout, with a dedicated UK team and a large community of adopters across the country.

Interested in Jamie? OUR NEXT FLIGHT IS 15th JUNE, HE COULD BE HOME WITH YOU SOONER THAN YOU MIGHT THINK!

When getting in touch, it helps if you can share a few details:

A brief description of your garden and the lowest fence height

Ages of children in or regularly visiting the home

How long Jamie might be left alone and how he’ll fit into your lifestyle

Please note:Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, and a commitment to neuter Jamie at the appropriate age (at your own expense).

If your circumstances change, you must notify Dali Dog Rescue UK immediately. Should rehoming become necessary, we will assist in placing Jamie directly from your home or, if needed and space allows, he must be returned to an approved Dali Dog Rescue volunteer.

Dogs may not be transferred to another UK rescue organisation under any circumstances. We are committed to Jamie’s lifelong welfare.

name: Cora
description:
Cora is a 7-year-old female Sabueso Hound. She weighs 21.6kg and has a height of 59cm, a length of 101cm, a neck circumference of 42cm, and a chest measurement of 69cm.

She was brought to the shelter because she was not suited for hunting, but she has many qualities that make her a wonderful companion.

Cora is an active and energetic girl who is always happy. She enjoys being around people and other dogs but also appreciates having some time to herself. Her lively nature means she would do well in a home that can provide her with regular exercise and mental stimulation.

She is good with other dogs but prefers to be in charge, so she would be best suited to a home where she can establish her role or with an owner experienced in managing confident dogs.

She is super sweet and sociable with people, making her a loving addition to the right home.

Cora needs some work on lead training as she is quite strong, but she is very obedient, which will help with further training. She travels well in the car, making her an easy companion for trips and outings.

So far, she has shown little interest in cats, but further introductions would be necessary.

Cora is currently in Spain but is available for adoption in the UK. Full rescue backup is provided to support her transition into her forever home. With her affectionate and lively personality, Cora will make a fantastic companion for the right owner.

name: Benny
description:
Benny is a 3 year old male crossbreed, currently at our shelter in Southern Spain but can travel to the UK.

Rescued from a municipal pound, Benny is a lovely happy-go-lucky dog who is great with people – he especially loves children and helping them to put away their toys!

He is an active dog who loves to run and play with other dogs at the shelter, and more than anything he loves sniffing and will spend most of his outside time pottering around the trees and bushes.

He can show dominant behaviours with male dogs and doesn’t like them entering his kennel space, but is fine around them when he is outside. He prefers females but if a male dog is relaxed, he is happy to be around them.

He is playful and really loves his walks but when he returns to his kennel, he is quite calm and happily waits until his next walk. Benny would suit an active home who will take him on lots of long walks and make sure that he gets lots of appropriate enrichment.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella. All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised.

Benny is neutered. Please note that we will advise results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Roxie
description:
Roxie is a delightful almost 4-year-old female cross-breed dog currently being fostered in the Poole.

She has shown remarkable adaptability during her journey to her foster home, indicating she travels well. Roxie is lead and harness trained, making walks a joy for both her and her owner.

Moreover, she’s already toilet trained, easing the transition into any new home environment.

Regarding her interactions with other pets, Roxie is described as “dog savvy” with cats, implying she can coexist peacefully with feline companions.

However, she’s not suitable for living with other dogs, as she exhibits reactivity towards them during walks. Therefore, it’s essential for Roxie to be the sole dog in her new home.

Additionally, she’s deemed suitable for households with older children aged 15 and above.

Despite her minor reactivity issue with other dogs, Roxie is affectionate and enjoys spending time with her human family, including cuddles and learning new commands.

A secure garden would be ideal for her to exercise and play freely.

To ensure her safety during walks, it’s recommended to use a no-escape harness.

name: Larry
description:
Larry is a 2 year old male hound cross who was born in May 2021 and is currently in a foster home in Oman.

Larry was rescued two years ago after he was reported living on the streets in an area that is dangerous for dogs. Unfortunately, we got to Larry’s friend too late and he was poisoned before we could rescue him but we luckily managed to rescue Larry.

He is a timid guy who’s wary of new people. This is unsurprising as he was treated badly on the streets, he had rocks thrown at him and was shouted at. He never associated humans with kindness.

He has been in a foster home with other dogs for over one year and has come on a long way. He will need a home with at least one other dog to make him feel more comfortable.

He will need very kind and patient owners who are understanding of his past and he will need time to settle in, trust and gain confidence. Larry is currently living with cats.

He is leash-trained and will go out for walks with the other dogs. He is not used to being around young children so a quieter home/ older children would be best for him.

He is healthy, weighs around 22kg, is neutered and is fully vaccinated. He is ready to travel to the UK now.

name: Mollie
description:
Mollie is a 3-year-old female Cross-Breed dog with stunning blue eyes, currently residing in Blackpool.

She’s a delightful companion, often found cuddled up on the sofa, cherishing moments of warmth and affection.

While walks might not be her forte due to her nervousness on the lead, she does appreciate having a garden to explore and roam freely.

In terms of companionship, Mollie is excellent with cats, displaying a friendly disposition towards them. However, she prefers to be the sole dog in the household, as she thrives better without canine companions.

Particularly, Mollie gravitates towards female company, making a female-only household her ideal environment.

Mollie has been neutered and is dual-chipped, ensuring her safety and compliance with regulations.

Given her preference for a tranquil environment, Mollie’s ideal home would be without children, providing her with the peace and stability she craves.

name: Tigi
description:
She has spent some time in a home environment, where it was noted that she resource guards items.

We are looking for an understanding home that can manage her resource guarding behaviour and has a good knowledge of the Akita breed.

Ideally, someone with an outside kennel setup for giving her some time out when needed.

Tigi is very loved at the kennels, but it’s not the same as having a home and family of her own.

She loves her walks and playtime, but she knows her own mind, and things are very much on her terms.

However, once you build a bond with her, it is incredibly rewarding.

name: Beanie
description:
Beanie is a 4-year-old female cross-breed.

Beanie endured hardship in Macedonia, where she was mistreated due to her origins.

Rescued and brought to Blackpool, UK, she experienced love from a caring woman but faced abandonment again when her owner needed surgery.

Now, Beanie seeks a child-free, female-only home, as she doesn’t get along with other dogs or cats. Despite her past, she’s spayed, vaccinated, and dual-chipped.

Trust takes time for Beanie due to her difficult past, but she’s ready to find a loving forever home.

name: Elvis
description:
He is 4 years old and a larger medium boy Cross-Breed currently in Blackpool (UK).

Elvis came to the UK as a young pup with his siblings after being saved in Romania and abandoned by his brothers and sisters.

He is a beautiful bouncy boy but he likes his time running and playing then likes nothing more than curling up and relaxing. Elvis likes routine and as he is nervous a couple of short quiet walks and the rest of the time just in the garden.

Elvis has had such a difficult time and never had a committed home.

At his first home, he was not properly cared for and when they took him to kennels his nails were overgrown to the point of causing pain and he had sores on his body and was terrified of everyone and everything.

Since then he has never found a home that has given him the time to settle and adjust to life in a loving home. He can’t be rushed and just needs time and lots of cuddles.

He is now back in an amazing rehab kennel in Blackpool where he has come on leaps and bounds and loves to play and bounce around with the staff who all love him dearly.

Elvis is a little too bouncy to live with children as he is described as Bambi on ice as he isn’t the most coordinated dog

He is good with dogs but we are looking for pet-free as he is so desperate to be loved that he struggles a bit to share his people

name: Nori
description:
Nori is a 10 month old female Saluki crossx who was born in Oman in November 2023. She’s quite small and weighs 14.5 kg. She’s currently in a foster home in Oman.

Nori was found when she was about 6 months old in a dangerous area in Muscat. Sadly, her siblings had been killed but Nori managed to get away. However, she was then hit by a car and suffered internal bleeding.

Consequently, she struggled to find food and was very malnourished and fearful of people when rescued.

She has been in a foster home since her rescue and has improved drastically. She has put on weight and now looks healthy. She knows a few commands such as paw, sit, come and is a very fast learner!

She loves being outdoors and is energetic when she wants to be. She is definitely slower to trust men over women, so will need very patient owners who will give her the time she needs to trust you and know that you aren’t a threat.

Nori gets along with cats, as there are cats currently in her foster home. She also enjoys the company of other dogs. Her foster mum says that Nori is “very playful, loves naps, and loves cuddling close to a person when sleeping.

She still shows signs of triggers from previous abuse but is open to trust if we’re patient.”

Nori is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and spayed. She will be ready to travel to the UK in January 2024.

name: Arthur
description:
This lovely lad is Arthur, an 8 year old male Akita. He came to us from the stray dog pound, where he was all alone and awaiting rescue.

Arthur is very lucky to have found himself a foster home to wait in comfortably until he finds his new family.

He has proved to be a fabulous and well-behaved boy in the home, housetrained and non-destructive, and he adores being around people.

He loves being out and about on an adventure, although he does initially pull a little on the lead. His foster carer is currently working on improving his lead training.

As Arthur came to us with no history, we are looking for an adult-only home or one with older, large-breed-aware children over the age of 12 years.

Arthur cannot be rehomed with cats, and although he walks fine with other dogs, we feel he would thrive as the only dog in his home where he can receive all the love and attention for himself.

If you think you can offer our handsome and loveable Arthur his forever home, we would love to hear from you.

name: Monty
description:
Monty is a 3 year old male Cross-Breed living in Scarborough, UK.

Let me introduce Monty and tell you a little about him…

This boy was born in a shelter in Romania; his mum was rescued and gave birth while in rescue, so lucky for this boy he didn’t have to face the streets.

His mum is a beautiful German Shepherd type girl and she is here within the UK, also adopted. This boy has not been so lucky.

He arrived in a home here in the UK as a small cute boy, and it seemed like his forever home. It wasn’t meant to be; it lasted a while, and he started to grow up and it just didn’t work anymore.

We had to act quickly, and he ended up in a shelter in Blackpool. This boy just needed someone to see past his size and the fact he hadn’t really been fully socialised. He spent a few months in shelter and even met his brother there.

Eventually, he ended up getting a foster placement with an amazing lady with bags of experience. He has settled as part of her pack, even down to living with a little doggie with disabilities. It hasn’t always been perfect.

He is very food-led and likes to bench surf; this is something that will need lots more work. He has had an argument or two with the other doggies, but let’s be honest, while dogs are finding a pecking order, this can happen.

He loves his walks, as you can see from the pics, and has lots of doggie friends on those walks. His foster truly has done all with him that he should have had when he was younger.

Now let’s find this boy a happy ever after like he deserves and help free his foster to help another.

Given Monty’s size and energy, he needs a home without young children and with experienced owners.

Monty loves routine and would make a great addition to a home that can provide him with the structure he loves.

name: Amlet
description:
Meet Amlet – A Gentle Soul Ready for His Second Chance

Hello, friends! My name is Amlet, and I’m a sweet-natured, friendly black Labrador cross, around 7 years young. For the past 2 years, I’ve been living at CyDRA shelter, patiently waiting for a forever home. Could it finally be with you?

I might not love labels, but I do embrace one classic Labrador trait with pride: I absolutely love food! Yes—I’m a proud foodie, and after what I’ve been through, I think I’ve earned it.

You see, I spent my entire life chained up, barely surviving on scraps of food and little water. Then one day, everything changed. A kind stranger saw me and contacted the vet services, who quickly called in a rescue team.

That’s how I finally got a chance at a better life—and moved into the shelter, where I learned what it means to be treated with love and respect.

Because of my difficult past, I can be a little unsure around other dogs at first. But with slow introductions, I warm up—and once I trust, I love deeply. I’ve shared my kennel happily with several female dog friends, and I do best in calm, respectful company.

There’s still so much of life I haven’t experienced—walks, treats, exploring, cuddles on the couch—but I’m ready to start now. I’m looking for a quiet, loving home where I can feel safe, relax, and show off my affectionate personality (and yes, my adorable fluffy tail).

I’d do best in a peaceful home, either as an only dog or with a calm female companion. Most of all, I just want someone to give me a chance—to help me write a new chapter filled with love, comfort, and joy.

I’m ready to pack my bags. Will you be the one to open your heart and welcome me home?

name: Godello
description:
Godello is a 1 year old male Griffon Cross. He needs a home and he is good with other doggies although he needs to be fed separately as he’s food possessive towards other doggies.

Godello is sociable with people he trusts, he’s a bit scared of strangers.

Godello is in Spain and we arranged everything for him to travel to the UK once an adoption appears. We are looking for a secure garden with fencing or walls to a minimum of 5ft.

We also need the dogs to be kept on a lead, long lunge lead or for people to use enclosed fields for off-lead exercise as these dogs are scent hounds & have hunting backgrounds. We do not rehome with children under 8 years old. He is full rescue backup is provided.

name: Tim
description:
Tim is a 1 year old male Griffon. He’s been fostered for more than a year and he is now ready to be adopted. Tim arrived petrified and scared of everything.

Tim is a very young dog and we do not know if he was mistreated or maybe not socialized, so Tim needs a super special and generous family.

Tim has been working with a behaviourist to allow humans to touch him. He has improved a tons but he still runs away if he doesn’t know someone. We think that living in a home will help him progress faster.

Tim has never walked on the lead so he will need a bit of work on that department too. Tim is the most gentle, noble and submissive soul one can meet.

Tim is scared and insecure but he has never had a bad word or shown any aggression towards any being.

Tim loves other dogs, he loves playing, running, and sleeping with them, and he’s super dog-friendly. So a home with at least another young, balanced, friendly, playful doggie is a must.

We believe kids are not a good idea right now as he’s too scared to tolerate the stress of living with little children.

With patience, time, love and routines, Tim will show his loving character and he will be an amazing addition to the family.

Please if you are an experienced person, and you want to help this little chap, contact me. He’s in Spain & we arrange everything for him to travel to the UK once an adoption appears.

We are looking for a secure garden with fencing or walls to a minimum of 5ft. We also need the dogs to be kept on a lead, long lunge lead or for people to use enclosed fields for off-lead exercise as these dogs are scent hounds & have hunting backgrounds. We do not rehome with children under 8 years old. He is full rescue backup is provided.

name: Senna
description:
Senna is a 2-year-old male Griffon in search of his forever home. This handsome boy is gentle and sweet-natured but can be shy when meeting new people. Initially, he tends to freeze and stay still, but once he builds trust, he reveals his affectionate and loving side.

Senna is very good with other dogs and will need a home with at least one balanced canine companion to help him feel secure. He thrives in the company of other dogs and benefits from their guidance and reassurance.

On the lead, Senna does quite well, but he is easily startled by loud noises and sudden movements. His adopter will need to be extra cautious to prevent any risk of him escaping. A patient and understanding home will be essential to help him gain confidence.

While Senna is scared of cats, this may be due to a lack of familiarity rather than aggression. He is quite good when travelling in a car, making trips and outings more manageable for his future family.

Currently in Italy, Senna is available for adoption in the UK, with full rescue backup provided. He will need a loving, patient home where he can continue to grow in confidence and feel safe.

name: Lillian
description:
Lillian is a 4 year old female small/medium cross breed.

Lillian is one of three dogs that we are trying to save from a shelter which is soon closing in Romania.

She is about four years old and is neutered.

She loves other dogs. She is curious about life but is a little shy with humans.

She will need an adopter who will be patient with her while she learns to trust.

She will need a quietish household. She could live with a family with dog savvy older children, a couple or an individual who would love a four-legged friend.

She is fully vaccinated and microchipped.

Unfortunately, we haven’t been able to catch test her.

Lillian has had the blood tests needed to travel to the UK and comply with DEFRA.

We give lifetime rescue back up for all our dogs.

name: Ringo
description:
Ringo is a 7 year old male Sarplaninac Cross under the care of Azil Danica (Network for Animals Bosnia).

He is a gentle giant with a heart even bigger than his size. Calm, stable, and shy by nature, he has spent his entire life in the shelter. Once, he was adopted to guard a house but was returned because he did not bark — he was simply too calm. Imagine that.

Yesterday, for the first time in his life, Ringo discovered toys and started to play. They took away his childhood and his youth, but he still believes in kindness.

He is wonderful with children, completely non-reactive towards other dogs and cats, and simply wants peace, warmth, and a place to finally rest his head in a home of his own.

Application and checks apply.Rescue support and backup in the UK via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Carmen
description:
Meet sweet little Carmen, an 8 year old female Podenco Maneto.

As Carmen grew older, her owners decided they didn’t want her anymore and left her at the pound.

Carmen is looking for her very own home and would prefer to be an only dog so she gets all the attention.

She enjoys a quiet home but loves to go out and run in a secure field.

Carmen doesn’t like cats, rabbits, or chickens, but she gets on okay with other dogs, as long as they aren’t too bouncy or busy.

Carmen loves going in the car and was no trouble at all at the vets. She loves her food and, for an older lady, is very energetic.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a 3 year old female Spanish mastin.

Bonnie spent her first two years of her life living in a pig sty, fed only on leftovers from the pigs.

She lived there with a male mastin Henry and despite their living conditions she gave birth to just one puppy – Tilly.

At this point her owner decided he didn’t want them any more, so he turned them out onto the streets and when they stayed close to the only place they knew he threatened to shoot them.

We were altered to them and arranged for them to be taken to a place of safety.

Bonnie is a gentle lady, who just wants a place to call home where she will be loved.

Bonnie will need a secure garden, in a rural/semi rural area. Someone with the time to teach her to trust again.

Bonnie gets on well with other dogs when out and about.

Her ideal home would be with a male dog or as an only dog. Bonnie has not been cat tested. She is good at the vets.

name: Tilly
description:
Tilly is a 2 1/2 year old female Spanish Mastin.

Tilly has had a sad start to her life. She was born in a pig sty and her owner decided he didn’t want her, or her parents – Bonnie and Henry. So he turned them out onto the streets.

They scavenged for food, and when they old owner saw them in quite a sorry state he threatened to shoot them. The family came into our March 2023.

Tilly was nursed back to health and has turned into a beautiful loving gentle lady. She is good at the vets and in the car.

Tilly has been around other dogs, and older children.

A secure garden, ideally rural/semi rural would be ideal. Tilly would be happy with another dog or as an only dog.

Tilly will need someone patient and understanding and have the time to continue her training.

Large breed experience preferred but not essential.

Tilly is in kennels in Cordoba, Spain, but is ready to travel to the right home.

name: Bentley
description:
Bentley is a 12-month-old male cross breed, currently residing in a private foster home in Romania. Weighing 10kg, he is vaccinated, blood-tested, flea/worm treated, neutered, and microchipped.

Bentley was found straying on the streets of Romania and is now in search of a loving family to call his own.

In his foster home, Bentley has not displayed any behavioural issues, making him a delightful companion. He is part of a household with other dogs, showcasing his compatibility with canine companions.

However, Bentley is not suited for a home with cats. He has been tested with various foods and shows no allergies, intolerances, or issues. Health-wise, Bentley has a clean bill, with no regular medication requirements.

When it comes to exercise, Bentley’s transition to a new home should initially focus on acclimating him to his surroundings. Positive support with the lead and harness is recommended, ensuring a smooth adjustment.

Bentley is looking for a home where people are mostly present, dedicated to his ongoing training, and can gradually increase his alone time.

Adopters must be mindful of their actions and expectations, paying attention to Bentley’s body language during potentially stressful interactions. A calm environment that offers structure and time for decompression is essential.

Positive reward training is encouraged, and a secure garden with a minimum 6ft boundary is required. Bentley is best suited to a home with no children or cats, and adopters should be prepared to provide toilet training support.

name: Penny
description:
Penny, a nine-month-old female, medium-sized crossbreed dog, awaits her forever family from Romania.

Found abandoned with her lineage a mystery, Penny’s journey has led her to seek love and companionship in a new home. Despite her tumultuous beginnings, Penny’s heart remains open, ready to embrace a family of her own.

In her foster home, Penny’s vibrant personality shines through, revealing a dog eager to explore the world and forge connections with both canine and human companions alike.

In the company of other dogs, Penny finds solace, relishing the opportunity to run and play. Her playful nature extends to her love for toys, with ball games holding a special place in her heart.

Penny’s affable demeanor extends to people as well, showing no fear towards men and displaying a friendly disposition towards all she meets. However, Penny’s distaste for solitude is evident, yearning for the company of her beloved humans.

While Penny may lack experience with children and cats, her curiosity knows no bounds, driving her to discover new adventures and experiences.

Despite her outgoing nature, Penny still requires guidance in certain situations, such as car rides and recall, highlighting her need for patient and loving training from her future family.

An ideal home for Penny would provide a secure garden for play and continued training, along with someone who possesses the time and patience to help her adjust to short periods of alone time.

Given her past experiences, Penny thrives in a rescue-experienced environment, where her unique needs can be understood and met with care.

Penny comes with a clean bill of health, having been vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, and microchipped. With her bright spirit and boundless potential, Penny eagerly awaits the chance to become a cherished member of a loving family.

name: Chita
description:
CHITA- BLACK LAB MIX – The Gentle, Wise Soul longing for a home!

CHITA is a 4-year-old Labrador size boy with a calm, wise nature and a heart full of kindness. He is a bit shy at first, but as soon as he hears your soft voice and receives the attention and cuddles, he opens up to show you his gratitude.

Chita was only a 6 month old puppy when he was rescued from a crowded kill shelter, where he was abused, and starving. His gentle nature however, remained untouched by the cruelty of his past.

His idea of happiness is a peaceful walk followed by lying quietly by his human’s feet, soaking up their presence with pure devotion. Chita has so much love to give, and all he asks for is a place to belong. Good with other dogs; Good with children

This fabulous boy would love to have a home to call his own, he has waited so long. Please get in touch if you’d like to adopt him, we would love to hear from you!

name: Allegra
description:
Allegra – 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed is the little dog who will steal your heart! Rescued on July 8th, 2024, she is truly perfect in every way. She has a gentle heart, a loving soul, and a happiness that shines through in every wag of her tail.

Allegra is everything you could ever want in a dog. She is calm, affectionate, and always ready to give love. She adores people, melts into cuddles, and greets everyone with a tail wag and a happy smile.

She’s fantastic with kids, other dogs, and everyone she meets. Whether you’re looking for a best friend, a family companion, or simply a dog to love and be loved by, Allegra is the one.

She will fit into any home and bring nothing but joy!

1.5 year old – young, loving, and full of warmthPerfect family dog – great with kids, adults, and other dogsGentle, affectionate, and loves human touchAlways happy, always wagging, always spreading loveWill make any home complete – a truly perfect companionAllegra is in perfect health:

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D tested & healthyBrucellosis tested

name: Kito
description:
Kito was pulled from one of the notorious kill stations. Kito is a 4 year old male Akita who was underweight and malnourished. He was in desperate need of a good meal—several meals by the look of him, as he was so thin.

He absolutely loved his new surroundings when he was taken into our care and gets on great with absolutely everyone.

He has the most amazing character, and everyone just loves him. Kito just oozes happiness whenever you see him—he is always so happy. He gets on great with the other dogs and loves to play. Kito is a fantastic dog and will love being part of a family.

Daily walks and playtime will keep him happy, and then he would love to just curl up in his own bed or beside you, knowing that this is how life should be. Kito will bring so much happiness, friendship, and loyalty to his family—he will be an absolute joy to have around.

We provide full rescue backup for the life of the dog, and you can be assured of our commitment to ensuring we match the right dog to the right family.

If this handsome boy has captured your heart, please get in touch! We would love to hear from you and tell you all about him.

name: Giani
description:
When we found Giani, a 3 year old male Cross-Breed, in the kill shelter in December 2024, he was caged alone.

But because he had already been torn apart.

Attacked by bigger dogs, Giani fought for his life. When the fight was over, he had lost his eye—but worse, he had lost his trust. Alone in his cage, he didn’t cry, didn’t beg, didn’t expect kindness. He had given up.

We reached out for him, and he flinched. We spoke softly to him, and he lowered his head. And when we gently touched him, he let out the deepest sigh—as if he had been waiting his whole life to feel safe.

He learned that not all hands hurt—some heal. He learned that not all dogs attack—some become friends. And he learned that not all humans leave—some stay. Today, Giani is no longer the broken soul we pulled from that cage.

He is warm, loving, and full of hope. He craves human touch, leans into affection, and just wants to belong.

He has learned to trust other dogs and now gets along beautifully. But there’s one thing he still doesn’t have—a home.

He lost an eye, but he never lost his heart. He carries the scars of his past, but he is ready to love with all that’s left.

Will you be the one to look into his remaining eye and say, “You’re home now”?

Giani has waited long enough. Let’s make sure he never waits again. Get in touch to find out how to adopt this truly special boy.

name: Kyle
description:
Kyle – 3-year-old male Labrador Retriever

Kyle was a ghost, slipping between the cracks of a world that had forgotten him. When we found him in a kill shelter in December 2024, he wasn’t barking for help, he wasn’t fighting for food—he was hiding in the farthest corner of the last cage, waiting to disappear.

Too weak to move. Too terrified to hope. Too broken to believe anyone would come for him. If we hadn’t seen him, truly seen him, Kyle wouldn’t have survived another day. He would have starved, been attacked, or simply faded away—forgotten.

So we saved him. But Kyle still doesn’t know he’s safe. He is gentle, but the world has not been gentle to him. He is kind, but he doesn’t yet believe in kindness.

Kyle has never been loved, and he doesn’t know what it feels like. He is struggling in the pension. The noise, the movement, the overwhelming presence of other dogs—it’s too much for a soul as fragile as his.

He doesn’t belong in a group setting. He needs peace, patience, and a heart willing to teach him what love truly means.

Kyle doesn’t need pity—he needs a chance. A chance to learn that hands can be gentle. A chance to wake up without fear. A chance to finally rest. He has already survived the impossible. Now, he just needs someone to show him that life can be beautiful, too.

name: Gabby
description:
Gabby is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed. She has had a rotten start to her little life. Our rescue team found her in the kill shelter with two puppies.

Gabby was a devoted Mum but tragically the puppies had parvo and did not survive, despite them fighting very hard.

Darling Gabby has overcome such tragedy and has shown to be kind, affectionate loving and playful. She is all so child friendly. Gabby so deserves her happily ever after!

If you can offer this beautiful girl a home we’d love to hear from you! Gabby comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and microchipped, has a passport and is neutered.

name: Maveric
description:
Maveric – 2 year old male Cross-Breed is the pocket rocket of happiness!

Maveric, our newest rescue, is a true bundle of joy on four paws! This little dynamo loves nothing more than zooming around and spreading happiness wherever he goes.

Maveric adores people of all sizes, especially kids, and dreams of finding a family where he can be the shining star. But Maveric also thrives on being the center of attention, so he would prefer to be the only pet in his forever home.

Maveric’s charm is undeniable—his bright eyes and wagging tail are sure to melt your heart! His playful antics and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for cuddles and adventures alike. Whether he’s chasing after toys or snuggling up on the couch, Maveric’s zest for life is contagious! With his agile moves and endearing personality, Maveric will light up anyone’s life!

Together, we can make Maveric’s dreams come true! If our little Top Gun has zoomed into your heart, please get in touch. We would love to hear from you!

name: Chestnut
description:
Chestnut is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed. He is a really lovely chap, he is energetic and fun and loves to play and run.

Chestnut can be shy with humans but soon warms up once he knows you, and is then affectionate and loving.

Chester has been cat tested and passed, but we cannot guarantee he will be friendly with every cat.

Chestnut is child friendly too. Chester is not keen on other dogs however and would need to be homed as the only dog.

As with all our dogs Chester comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and neutered, has a passport and is microchipped.

name: Petra
description:
Petra is a 5 year old female Labrador Cross. She is a sweetheart, she is great with the other dogs and has shown herself to be sweet and loving.

Petra can be a bit of a loner watching on, but she is not worried just enjoys her own company. With humans, she can be shy, but we believe she will grow in confidence with her own home.

Petra is child-friendly and ignores cats. She will be a great dog to have as a companion!

Petra comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and microchipped, has a passport and is spayed.

name: Yasmin
description:
Yasmin is a 15-month-old female Cross-Breed. She was rescued on July 8th, 2024, along with her sister, when she was just a 7-month-old puppy. Since then, she has been on a journey of learning to trust people and adjusting to a life filled with love and care. Though initially shy, Yasmin’s gentle nature is unmistakable, and she has already made great progress in overcoming her fears.

She finds great comfort in the company of other dogs, enjoying their presence and playful interactions. Being around her canine companions helps her feel safe and secure, and she thrives in an environment where she has the support of friendly dogs. While Yasmin is still learning to fully trust humans, she shows a sweet and affectionate side that continues to grow with time and patience.

With consistent love and reassurance, Yasmin is expected to blossom into a confident and happy companion. She enjoys human contact, and while she may need extra time to feel completely comfortable, she has already come a long way. Her resilience and ability to adapt show just how much potential she has to become a loving and devoted pet.

Yasmin is in excellent health and fully prepared for her forever home. She has been 4D tested, spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated, and tested for Brucellosis. She also has her own passport, making her ready to travel to her new family.

At just 15 months old, Yasmin is still very much a young and playful girl. She has a beautiful appearance and a gentle personality that will flourish in the right home. If given the patience and kindness she deserves, she will undoubtedly reward her new family with love and loyalty.

If Yasmin has captured your heart, please reach out. She is waiting for a loving home where she can continue to grow into the wonderful dog she is meant to be.

name: Bailey
description:
Bailey is a beautiful, gentle soul who has endured a heartbreaking past. Rescued from a notorious kill shelter, she carries the emotional scars of being attacked by other dogs.

Fearful and timid, Bailey flinches at shadows and unexpected sounds, struggling to overcome her trauma. Despite her past, she remains a kind and loving girl who just needs a safe, patient home where she can heal.

Bailey has “cherry eye,” a treatable condition, and is otherwise in good health. She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, 4D tested, and brucellosis tested.

With her own passport, she is ready to travel to a forever home where she will finally experience love and safety.

Bailey is good with children and would thrive in a home that can provide her with security, patience, and gentle encouragement.

She is looking for a hero to help her move past her fears and discover happiness again.

name: Duke
description:
Duke is a 1 year old male Mastiff Cross. He is a big, soppy boy who has a loving nature and is looking for a new home.

With his size and playful personality, he is best suited to a home with another large, nice-natured dog who can match his energy and keep him company.

Duke loves people and dogs alike, but because of his clumsy and boisterous ways, he is not suitable for a home with small dogs.

Despite his size, he is a well-mannered lad who walks nicely on a lead, responds well to guidance and is eager to please. His affectionate nature shines through, making him an incredibly loving companion.

Duke will need a home where someone is around for most of the time, though he can be left for a few hours once he has bonded with the resident dog.

A secure garden and plenty of space to play are important for him, given his size and energy levels. He is fully vaccinated but still too young to be neutered.

Duke is great with children who are dog respectful, though due to policy he cannot be placed in a home with children under 8. He is not suitable to live with cats, but for the right family, he will be a loyal and affectionate friend.

name: Micky
description:
Micky is a 3year old male cross breed currently in Spain.

Friendly Micky is happy and affectionate. He is a medium sized crossbreed, with a tan, short coat and an attractive black masked face. Micky is a friendly chap, he’s very loving and has lots of energy.

He likes to be with other dogs and he will grow to medium size and be a chunky boy, so we are looking for a home with or without another friendly dog, and no cats, as he was tested and didnt like them. We think children need to be over 13 years.

Micky has low level Leish, and he takes a tablet each day to keep him safe. The tablets are about £4 for a months supply.

name: Fergus
description:
Fergus is a 12-month-old male Cross-Breed. He is currently located in Spain and is looking for a loving family in the UK. Fergus is a medium-sized dog, standing around 24 inches at the shoulder and weighing 25kg.

He has a sleek black coat with a striking white chest and an affectionate, happy-go-lucky nature that makes him instantly likeable.

Fergus is friendly, playful, and gets on brilliantly with his kennel mates. Although he has settled well into kennel life, what he really needs is a forever home of his own.

He’s eager to please and quick to learn, making him a fantastic companion for the right family. Fergus has seen cats through a fence and seemed fine, but he has not been fully tested with them.

He is neutered, has started his vaccinations, is blood-tested clear, and comes with his own passport.

He is now ready to travel to the UK to join a home where he can be cherished and continue to thrive.

name: Freddie
description:
Freddie is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed. He’s currently living in a loving foster home in Norfolk, where he’s surrounded by caring humans, dog friends, and even a cat who apparently thinks it’s one of the pack.

Freddie’s had quite the journey—originally from Romania, he spent over five years in a home before sadly being returned due to his sensitivity to loud noises and the arrival of a new baby.

Though he’s a larger dog in size, Freddie is all heart and very sensitive at his core. He’s not a fan of loud or sudden noises, and busy, bustling environments make him anxious.

For this reason, he needs a calm, quiet home—somewhere peaceful and predictable, ideally in a rural or low-traffic area.

Freddie is not suited to a city lifestyle or a home with children, but he would thrive in a calm, adult-only home with understanding people who get that he’s a bit of a gentle soul.

He does well with dog-savvy cats and currently lives with other dogs. He adores playing with his best friend, a smaller collie mix, but he can be wary of unfamiliar or larger dogs when out and about.

With the right setup and a patient adopter who’s willing to give him the time he needs, Freddie will reward them with deep loyalty, quiet companionship, and a big heart full of love.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is a 6 year old male Lurcher still looking for a new home. He initially arrived in November 2019 and is labrador-sized.

PLEASE READ THE FULL DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING.

We have no known history for Eric as he was originally an unclaimed stray. He loves other dogs whilst out for walks and has lived with other dogs at the sanctuary. Eric is best suited to medium to large confident female dogs.

He has grown in confidence with us at the sanctuary but is initially timid of new people, particularly men. Eric can be the only dog at home but would also be happy to live with another confident female.

He is initially shy in new surroundings but once he becomes familiar, he is very good. Eric is more comfortable around women, and we feel a quiet home with no children or cats and few visitors would be best.

Eric will likely accept a male in the home but will always choose the lady first. Once he feels comfortable, he is a very happy and playful boy. He would be happy in a home where someone is around for most of the time—perhaps an active retired lady or couple.

Eric has previously been adopted but was returned due to his nervous reaction towards a stranger when out walking. He needs time and understanding as he is a real gentleman and perfect indoors. He is very clean indoors and loves his food—he could easily develop the figure of a Labrador if left to eat the quantities he’d like!

Eric is a perfectly adoptable dog, and we would love to see him settled in a new home. With the team here, he loves us, and he really is no trouble. It’s just a case of getting to know each other, building a bond, and knowing how to manage certain behaviours.

name: Greg
description:
Greg is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed currently residing in Lousã, central Portugal. Found abandoned along with his brother Peck near a shelter, these two pups were in dire straits – alone, scared, and emaciated.

Thanks to the care they received, both Peck and Greg have made remarkable recoveries and are now healthy little pups eagerly awaiting their forever homes.

While the exact breed of these pups remains uncertain, there’s a hint of Portuguese Podengo in their lineage, and they are expected to be small to medium-sized when fully grown.

Greg, in particular, showcases a timid demeanor owing to early mistreatment, but he readily places his trust in humans. His confidence shines through when interacting with other dogs, as he shares a kennel with three other puppies.

Recently introduced to harnesses and leads, Greg is already adapting well and is poised to become an ideal companion for someone willing to invest time and effort into a puppy’s training.

As part of the adoption process, Greg has undergone essential procedures like microchipping, vaccination, and health testing.

The adoption fee for Greg is £450, covering not only these medical necessities but also the cost of transportation to the UK facilitated by a reputable company. Adopters can be assured of full foster backup, ensuring a smooth transition for Greg into his new home.

name: Peck
description:
Peck is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed, discovered alongside his brother Greg, abandoned near the shelter in Lousã, central Portugal.

These poor pups were rescued, underweight and frightened, and have since received nourishment and tender care, transforming into healthy and vibrant little companions eager to find their forever homes.

While the exact breed remains uncertain, there’s a suggestion of Portuguese Podengo in Peck and Greg, anticipating a small to medium size when fully grown.

Despite their challenging start in life, Peck, though initially timid, readily places trust in humans and exhibits confidence around other dogs.

He currently shares a kennel with three other puppies, demonstrating his sociable nature. Peck has shown positive responsiveness to harness training, allowing for easy lead walks.

He holds great potential to become a delightful companion, provided with the dedication and training that a young pup requires.

As part of the adoption process, Peck has been chipped, vaccinated, and health-tested, ensuring his readiness for a new home.

The adoption fee of £450 covers not only Peck’s well-being but also includes transport to the UK through a reputable company, comprehensive foster support, and the necessary vaccinations for the journey.

name: Cade
description:
Cade is a 1 year old male Sharpei Cross. His current weight is 29kg.

Cade is looking for a new home where he’ll be very much involved in what’s going on.

Cade is very enthusiastic when meeting new people and can be overwhelming for some.

A family experienced in handling dogs is preferred.

Cade is very sociable around other dogs and can live with a dog-savvy cat.

Due to his “bull in a china shop” manner, a home with no children is preferred, although Cade can live with teenagers.

He is crate trained and sees the crate as his time to chill.

Cade isn’t used to being left alone and has always had the company of other dogs, so this will need to be gradually built up in his new home.

Cade is very food-driven, which benefits his training.

All applicants must live within 1 hours drive from Upminster Essex.

name: Dobbie
description:
Our extra special boy Dobbie most certainly is extra special! He is approximately two years old and a Greek Shepherd cross. Dobbie weighs a mere thirty-five kilos and is magnificent.

He was surrendered to our Corfu shelter a year ago with his sister as their owner was unable to keep them any longer.

Dobbie is striking and a real showstopper. His black coat with his white chest, tummy and tips are just glorious. The breed is known for its gentility and kindness and Greek Shepherds make wonderful family pets.

Experienced adopters will recognise however that there can be a tendency to be a little overprotective with their loved ones.

Dobbie loves water and thoroughly enjoys his walks and recreational pursuits. Sadly, Dobbie walks with a slight limp having had surgery for hip dysplasia. A veterinary report is available.

Dobbie walks nicely on his lead. He seems to mix well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Celine
description:
Our extra special girl Celine is approximately three years old and a medium sized cross breed.

Celine weighs twenty-three kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Celine has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Celine is the most strikingly attractive dog. She has a soft brown and white coat, gorgeous ears and beautiful eyes that are totally and absolutely engaging.

The shelter manager describes Celine as an exceptionally loving girl. She so loves socialising, and her biggest passion is her tennis ball.

Celine is pleasant, well behaved and affable which presents her as an easy-going low maintenance adoption candidate.

Whoever is Celine’s fortunate adopter they will be truly blessed and very lucky to have her as part of their lives.

Celine mixes perfectly well with cats, other dogs and children. She walks nicely on her lead albeit with a foible. Celine stops after approximately four paces and then likes to catch up.

name: Fenton
description:
Fenton, is we believe, between eighteen months and two years old and a wire-haired pointer or thereabouts.

Fenton has been in our Cyprus Shelter for just a couple of months, having been found abandoned on the streets.

Fenton sounds like he would make a wonderful addition to any family!

His relaxed demeanour and easy-going nature make him an excellent candidate for adoption.

His ability to get along well with other animals and children also makes him very adaptable to different household environments.

He is strikingly good-looking and a handsome boy with his black, grey and brindle coat.

It is great to hear that Fenton walks nicely on a lead as this suggests he is open to training and willing to please.

As Fenton is still relatively young, he is likely has plenty of energy for walks and playtime, but he will also appreciate some quiet time for relaxation.

Overall, it sounds like Fenton has a lot to offer to a lucky family or individual.

With his friendly disposition and adaptability, he is sure to bring joy and companionship wherever he goes.

Please open your heart and give Fenton his forever home where he can be loved and cherished.

name: Lasi
description:
Our extra special girl Lasi is approximately two years old and a very splendid cross breed at the bottom end of medium. Lasi weighs just fourteen kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Lasi has been in our Cyprus shelter for four months.

Lasi has been described by our shelter manager as calm, sweet, eager to please and will make a fabulous family dog.

Her appearance is breathtaking with a light tan coat and a graduated darker tan along her back. Gorgeous hazel eyes and beautiful ears are showstoppers.

Lasi will fit into her forever home so well and will bring years of joy and happiness to her very fortunate adopters.

Lasi walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with children, cats and other dogs.

name: Frankie
description:
Our extra special boy Frankie is just under one year old and a rather dapper small cross breed with a strong beagle appearance.

Frankie weighs a humble eight kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having arrived at our Cyprus shelter as part of an unwanted litter, Frankie has been there most of life.

Frankie has a powerful facial expression which is nicely enhanced by his woeful puppy dog eyes. With the most appealing ears and a wonderful tri colour coat. Frankie’s appearance could best be described as a showstopper.

Our shelter manager describes Frankie as lively and bubbly with a great love for humans.

Recognising that he is fairly high energy, Frankie would be best suited to a family with a busy lifestyle including lots of walks and exercise.

Frankie’s nature is sublime, and his adopters will be overjoyed and truly blessed.

Frankie walks reasonably well on his lead but would benefit from more training. He enjoys his time in the car, and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lily
description:
Our extra special girl Lily is approximately six years old and a near perfect cross breed at the bottom end of medium sized. Lily weighs just fourteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found on the streets Lily has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Our shelter manager reports that Lily is very timid and needs lots of reassurance. She is quiet, very sweet and walks beautifully on her lead. Which begs the question: what more does a girl have to do?

Lily is so attractive with her shining black coat and delicate features. Her gorgeous eyes are perfectly enhanced with her prize-winning ears and sublime expressions.

A very discerning adopting family will recognise the prize that Lily represents. She will be so grateful to join a quiet family in an orderly house with a steady routine. Paradise for all concerned.

Lily seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Serena
description:
*** SERENA WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 1ST NOVEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special girl Serena is approximately two years old and a medium sized cross breed perhaps with something of a hound content.

Serena weighs thirteen kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Serena has been in our Cyprus shelter for around four months.

Our shelter manager describes Serena as very sweet and she has an exceptionally loving personality. Serena enjoys amazing eye contact with her favourite human and constantly wins numerous hearts.

Her sandy coat is beautifully enhanced with a white flash to her chest along with four white toe tips. Her ears are gorgeous and probably award winning, leaving Serena as visually stunning.

Serena is the ideal adoption candidate and will make a perfect addition to her forever family. She is so deserving.

Serena enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. She also seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Tamsin
description:
Our extra special girl Tamsin is approximately two years old and the most beautiful mixed breed with something of a hound appearance.

Tamsin weighs a delightful thirteen kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Tamsin has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Our shelter manager reports that Tamsin has the sweetest and calm personality, and she thoroughly enjoys walking on the lead where her behaviour is exemplary.

Tamsin has a wonderful personality and exudes kindness and empathy. She thoroughly enjoys her time with her human companions and shares happiness and affection.

Tamsin is absolutely beautiful with her rich tan and black coat, puppy dog eyes, striking ears and a near perpetual smile. Film star quality looks to say the very least. Tamsin is the ideal adoption candidate who is ready made for a kind and loving family.

Tamsin enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats, kittens, children and donkeys.

name: Harley
description:
Our extra special girl Harley is approximately five years old and an incredibly attractive small cross breed. Harley weighs just twelve kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw.

Harley has been in our Cyprus shelter for six weeks having been found abandoned on the streets.

Our shelter manager describes Harley as very loving and perfectly behaved. With impeccable manners and a near perpetual smile she is an absolute delight.

Harley’s personality attracts a huge fan club among the shelter staff and volunteers, and she is everyone’s favourite.

She is visually stunning with her pretty face and tri colour coat. Harley is at her happiest having fun with people and cherishes every moment on a lap or having a cuddle.

She is exceptionally low maintenance and will make a wonderful addition to her adopting family.

Harley enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs and children. She is not however cat tolerant.

name: Jasmine
description:
Our extra special girl Jasmine is approximately one year old and a delightful small cross breed. Jasmine weighs a humble seven kilos and measures eleven inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Jasmine has been in our Cyprus shelter for three weeks.

Jasmine is stunningly attractive. She has incredibly delicate features and the most beautiful facial expressions. This blends so well with her bubbly and fun-loving disposition.

Jasmine’s coat and markings are sublime. She has some classic black and tan with a distinctive white flash to her chest. And then there’s the gorgeous half tone brindle along her back. If ever a dog were to stand out from the crowd it would be Jasmine.

She is youthful, fun loving, affable and affectionate. Jasmine so yearns for human interaction and will make a glorious family dog.

Jasmine will benefit from more lead training but so enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs and children but has a strong desire to chase cats.

name: Hannah
description:
Our extra special girl Hannah is approximately three years old and a cross breed at the very bottom end of medium with a strong beagle appearance.

Hannah weighs a perfect eleven kilos and measures thirteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Hannah has been in our Cyprus shelter for three weeks.

Having clearly been preloved, Hannah is finding shelter life not to her liking. She is longing for her forever home away from the noise and bustle.

Hannah leans towards being timid but will thrive and blossom with her very fortunate adopting family. She yearns for peace and routine and will repay love and kindness with huge premiums.

Hannah’s appearance is exceptional in every aspect. Her tricolour coat is just glorious with some freckles and the loveliest ears ending in a point. Her kind, empathetic and loving nature abounds. Hannah is a truly wonderful adoption candidate.

She enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. Hannah seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Laura
description:
Our extra special girl Laura is approximately three years old and the most stunning medium sized cross breed. Laura weighs just twelve kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Laura has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Laura can be best described as incredibly close to canine perfection.

Her smile is perpetual, her eyes are bright and engaging, her ears are prize winning, her teeth are shining white, and her glorious tri-colour coat is enhanced by an array of freckles and a pigmented tummy.

She adores her play time with her friends and engages beautifully with her bubbly sweet personality. If ever there was a prime adoption candidate designed to make a family unbelievably happy it’s Laura.

She walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. Laura seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lonzo
description:
Poor Lonzo, an 18 month old male Labrador Retriever Cross, hasn’t had the best run of luck since arriving in the UK.

His first home felt he was too bouncy for their young son, and now sadly his second home feel they can’t offer him the kind of lifestyle he truly needs.

Lonzo is, and has always been, a silly, goofy boy with a big personality, no understanding of personal space or his size, and a boisterous (but innocent) play style. He’s looking for an active home that can give him all the fun and fuss he’s desperate for.

Lonzo was found without a collar or microchip, wandering the outskirts of Nicosia in Cyprus earlier this year, looking for food and water.

He is estimated to be around 1-2 years old, so still quite a young dog who definitely needs some focus and continued training in a new home.

He absolutely loves people and believes everyone is his bestie. He loves any kind of attention and is a very sociable boy who loves to please people.

Although Lonzo is currently living as the only resident dog, he would benefit from a settled resident dog to learn from.

He was always very adaptable to new kennel mates in Cyprus, and has attended daycare in the UK where he was a very friendly boy towards everyone.

A resident dog would be great for him to learn some manners, to settle at home, and simply to have a best friend to play with too.

Lonzo’s foster family describe him as funny, very friendly, and a little bit dopey! He loves his bed, is a sucker for a belly rub, and just wants to be involved in everything.

He is an excitable, enthusiastic boy and can be quite jumpy, but he doesn’t mean to cause any bother – he is just always on a mission to make new friends.

Because of this, we think he would be better suited to a home with children aged 10+ so he doesn’t knock anyone over, as he is a strong dog.

Lonzo is still getting to grips with lead training, and gets very excited to go outside. After around 15 minutes he really calms down and walks well on the lead, so it will just take a bit of continued training and consistency.

On walks he is happy to say hello to anyone and everyone, dogs and people.

Lonzo is looking for a semi-rural home with a garden and an active lifestyle. He would prefer an away from busy roads and lots of noise, and wouldn’t enjoy being left at home alone for extended periods of time.

He very much wants to be involved and in good company, as he’s people oriented, and he loves being outdoors, exploring, sniffing and chasing birds and squirrels. He is also a water baby and loves to splash about!

Lonzo is a fantastic character and anyone who adopts him will be very lucky to welcome him into the family. He is big and bouncy, but also has a huge heart and such a willingness to learn.

He’s smart, incredibly loyal, and will truly make the best friend given the opportunity.

name: Rodney
description:
Rodney is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old.Rodney – fostered in Norwich Norfolk.

Rodney was abandoned outside the shelter at Crivatu with his siblings four years ago. Three of the litter came to the UK as pups but sadly two remained.

As nice as the shelter at Crivatu is it’s not a substitute for a real home and family and we are so hoping that at last Rodney will get his chance.

Rodney is a friendly little chap who loves a cuddle and is very much a lap dog. He enjoys his walks and is well behaved when out. He could live with another female dog but would be very happy to be the only dog in the home. He needs an adult home.

name: Darcy
description:
Darcy is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She’s a beautiful, friendly girl with a sweet nature and a big heart. Rescued from a terrible kill shelter, she’s now ready for a second chance at life and dreaming of a loving home in the UK.

It’s hard not to fall for her hopeful eyes and wagging tail that seem to say she knows her best days are yet to come.

Darcy’s love for people shines through in everything she does. She adores human attention, greeting everyone with warmth and trust despite her past. Her temperament is well-balanced — gentle, affectionate, and eager to please.

With her cheerful attitude, she’s bound to bring light and happiness to any home that welcomes her.

At the shelter, Darcy has shown herself to be a good girl with other dogs, interacting politely and confidently. She can be cat tested if needed, showing just how adaptable and eager she is to fit into different family environments.

Because she hasn’t had experience with very young children, a home with kids aged eight and over would be most suitable, giving her space to feel comfortable while still enjoying family life.

Weighing around 17 kilograms, Darcy is a medium-sized dog who’s already neutered, fully vaccinated, and has completed her full blood tests. She’s all set to travel with her passport and join her forever family directly — no delays, just love and new beginnings.

Darcy is ready to leave the shelter behind and step into a home where she’ll be cherished for the wonderful dog she truly is. Her rescue story may have started in hardship, but her future promises to be bright, filled with warmth, affection, and security.

name: Greyson
description:
Greyson is an eight month old cross-breed pup who will grow to be around medium sized. Greyson fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Greyson was found on the side of a road in Romania with his brother. They were feeding from the corpse of a deceased dog as there was no other food source around. Sadly Greysons brother later died of parvo after they were rescued.

Despite this horrific start in life Greyson has arrived in the UK and is quite a character. Just a cheeky little chap on the look out for his next bout of fun. He mixes well with other dogs and would like another dog in his forever home.

He is a little wary of strangers but once he connects with you he will be your very best friend. Greyson wants to play with the safe rescue cat and can live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Max
description:
Max is a male, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old.  Max fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Max and his mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Max is initially a little timid but is learning the ways of his new world in his UK foster home. He would benefit from the company of another dog in his forever home but could also be the only pet.

He would be ok to live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Marlowe
description:
Marlowe is a 8-year-old male Husky Cross. He is currently in foster care in Lincolnshire and is looking for his forever home.

This sweet boy does have some health challenges, as he is already blind in one eye and sadly losing sight in the other. Despite this, Marlowe doesn’t let it get him down and remains a loving, affectionate companion.

Marlowe is well known for his cuddly nature, earning himself the title of a cuddle monster. He absolutely thrives on human company and enjoys being close to people.

He has so much affection to give, and his future family will quickly see just how loyal and gentle he can be.

Marlowe is described as extremely well behaved, making him a joy to have around the home. He gets on well with other dogs, showing that he is sociable and adaptable.

He has already been neutered and microchipped, which means some of the important essentials are already taken care of.

This lovely Husky Cross comes with lifetime rescue backup (RBU), showing the commitment of those who care about him to ensure he is supported throughout his life.

His only wish is to find someone who can accept his vision loss and love him for the wonderful dog he truly is. Please consider Marlowe—he has so much love still to share.

name: Lotty
description:
Lotty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old.

The team met Lotty on their trip to Roxanas shelter back in June. She was a late addition to the transport list after they noticed that she was getting severely picked on by her pen mates every time the dogs all barked.

It was decided she really needed to be free from the bullies and so she was swiftly added.

Lotty is a timid girl initially who is not brave in new situations. She is learning to accept new things all the time and becoming braver but will still need to gain life experience in her forever home.

Once comfortable she is cheeky and affectionate and great fun. Lotty will need an adult family with one other dog in the household as full time resident. She has been fine with the safe rescue cat but may chase a more nervy cat when she found her feet.

name: Letty
description:
Letty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Letty fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Letty has come into our care recently due to a change in domestic circumstances. She is a quiet and sweet girl who is initially timid with new people.

She will need a confident dog to buddy up to in her forever home and when she sees them relaxed and approaching people for fuss she will then follow suit. She would therefore not be happy as the only dog in the home.

Letty would like a quiet and calm home with no children under the age of twelve. She walks nicely on a lead and has met amicably with the safe rescue cat.

name: Skye
description:
Meet Skye, a two year old extra large male Cane Corso Cross. He’s a big, bouncy boy full of energy and affection, with that classic Cane Corso enthusiasm that can fill a room.

Skye is strong on the lead and tends to pull when out walking, but he’s doing well with muzzle training and is extremely food-motivated — a huge bonus for anyone who enjoys training with treats!

Skye hasn’t shown any signs of aggression toward his trusted volunteer in kennels, though he does like to bark at people and dogs — typical Cane Corso behavior.

He’s a loving dog who thrives on affection and attention. Skye would do best in a calm home without other pets or children, where he can get consistent training and structure.

He’ll need a dedicated owner who understands his background and is willing to help him move forward with patience and guidance. Skye must be walked on a muzzle, 5-point harness, and lead at all times — never off lead — to keep him safe.

He generally walks well but can get excited and grab the lead; with ongoing training, he’s learning to stop when told.

Skye will need someone around most of the time, with alone time introduced gradually once he’s settled. His new home should have a secure property and garden to prevent escape.

While he was house-trained in his previous home, he may need a quick refresher after his time in kennels.

Skye has missed out on a lot of love, but with trust and time, he’ll give back tenfold and become a loyal, affectionate companion.

name: Scribble
description:
Scribble is a largeish crossbreed aged around three years old. He has come into our care recently due to his owner not being able to care for him. Scribble fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Scribble is a great dog, very gentle despite his size and extremely placid. Due to lacking socialisation in his previous home he is playing a bit of catch up out in the big wide world but he is learning fast and has the makings of a wonderful family member.

Scribble would like the company of another dog in his forever home, he’s also extremely well behaved around cats, rabbits and goats!

He could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He would be shy initially but with a little time and understanding would soon be a loving addition to the family.

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is a German shepherd cross aged around four years old. Alfie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Alfie and his siblings were found as puppies in a wood yard in Romania adjacent to a very busy highway. The three pups were rescued and taken to a safe shelter where they grew up safely.

Alfie’s two sisters, Alice and Alba, were adopted along the way but Alfie has spent four years waiting for his chance to come to the UK to find a home.

Alfie is a biggish chap who would suit an experienced shepherd owner. He is mixing well with dogs in his foster home but maybe best as an only dog or with just one steady female.

He has met the very robust safe rescue cat and ignored him. Alfie has little experience with children and we would be looking for a home with no children under the age of twelve.

Alfie loves his walks and walks nicely on a lead.

name: Aria
description:
Meet Aria, a two year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross who’s medium to large in size.

Aria is a big-hearted girl with a lot of love to give, but she’s currently very overweight and needs someone experienced with large breed dogs who can provide her with structure, patience, and consistent boundaries.

Aria is a large, very overweight dog who needs someone experienced with large breed dogs and can teach her clear boundaries. They need to be confident in their training abilities or be prepared to seek out help from a trainer.

She needs regular exercise in a safe environment such as a dog field until she has built up her confidence around other dogs again. She will need to be on a strict diet to get her down to a sensible weight.

It is felt that Aria has become both traumatised and overprotective in her current home. She will need someone who is around most of the time but will build up some alone time for her too.

She has previously used a crate and may feel more secure using one again. She will need to be trained to use a muzzle and walk on a lead or long line at all times.

As Aria has been unpredictable with men lately, it is felt that she would be more suited to a female-only home. She needs to be treated like a dog and not a baby, have clear boundaries, and someone who can stick to them.

She is a dog with a lot of love to give but needs to be given time and patience to settle into her new home and understand her boundaries.

Aria travels well in the car and likes looking out of the window. Aria is a young girl who just needs someone with experience that understands her past is unknown but can work on her future together.

name: Badger
description:
Badger is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Badger fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Badger originally into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He arrived a couple of months ago and was swiftly adopted but has sadly been reluctantly returned due to his energy levels not matching the home environment.

Badger is a brilliant character who gets on with everyone and everything. He is friendly and affectionate and a busy boy who wants to be involved in all the family goings on.
