He will need a decent level of exercise in his forever home and some basic training to channel his enthusiasm for jumping up. He can live with or without other dogs and is fine with cats. He could live with respectful children of ten plus.

name: Kori
description:
Kori is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around five years old. Kori fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Kori has come into our care recently after his adopters circumstances changed and they could no longer adequately care for a dog.

Kori is a beautiful sweet natured boy. He is friendly and playful with other dogs but could also live as the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus and has been fine with introductions to the safe rescue cat.

name: Kyro
description:
Welcome the very definition of joy in dog form — Kyro! Kyro is a four year old male Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross, medium in size, with a huge grin, a happy-go-lucky personality, and endless enthusiasm for life. He’s truly impossible not to love.

Kyro is a fun-loving, affectionate lad who absolutely adores people. He’s happiest when he’s part of the action — whether that’s playtime in the garden, exploring new places on walks, or curling up nearby for a well-earned snooze afterwards.

He thrives on human companionship and has a wonderful, cheeky charm that makes everyone who meets him smile.

He’s also a clever boy who loves to learn. Kyro responds brilliantly to positive reinforcement and enjoys training sessions that keep his brain busy. He’s eager to please and loves to show off his progress — especially if there are treats or cuddles involved!

Kyro can be a little reactive towards other dogs, but we’re already helping him with this. With patient, careful introductions and ongoing guidance, he’s making fantastic progress.

He’s learning that not all dogs are something to worry about, and with continued support in his new home, he’ll only keep improving.

Kyro is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and awaiting castration, so he’s almost ready to start his next chapter with a loving forever family.

He’s currently in kennels, where he’s adored by everyone who meets him — but despite all the love and attention, Kyro does find kennel life a little stressful.

He would much prefer the comfort and calm of a home environment, where he can properly relax and show just how wonderful he really is.

Kyro is looking for a pet-free, adult-only home where he can be the centre of attention. He loves people, but he’ll thrive best in a calm, consistent environment without other pets or children.

If you’re looking for a companion who’ll make you laugh every single day and fill your home with warmth, Kyro might just be your perfect match.

name: Rama
description:
Rama is a medium sized crossbreed aged around a year old. Rama fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Rama was a pup born to a chained mum in Romania. Thankfully she was spared the horrendous fate of chained life when all of the dogs were handed over to a rescuer, Rama and her mother included.

Rama is a quiet and sweet little girl who has lived in the shadow of her mum at the shelter. She’s now in a UK foster home and time spent with people is resulting in her absolutely flourishing.

She is a quiet little girl, currently a little serious for her age, hopefully in the coming weeks she will learn more about the fun side of life.

She mixes well with other dogs and is fine with the safe rescue cat, she could also be the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged six plus.

name: Mandy
description:
Mandy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Mandy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Mandy belonged to a policeman in Romania. She lived her life on the end of a chain having litter after litter of puppies.

This miserable existence at last came to an end when he gave her and her current pups to a horrible shelter where conditions were dire. Thankfully they were rescued from there and taken to the nice shelter where we met them.

Mandy is now in a UK foster home and time spent with people is resulting in her absolutely flourishing. She is a quiet little girl who can’t quite believe her change of luck.

She is quiet, sweet and affectionate and would make a lovely addition to the home of a retired person or couple. Mandy would like to be the only dog in the home but could live with another as calm as she is.

She could live with respectful children aged ten plus. She is ok with the safe rescue cat.

name: Ebony
description:
Ebony is a 1-year-old female Cross-Breed. She’s a small dog weighing around 12 kilograms, with a soft, sweet expression that perfectly matches her gentle personality.

Her name might sound dark and mysterious, but underneath, she’s a sensitive soul with a big heart just waiting to shine.

At first, Ebony can be a little shy, especially in new surroundings or with unfamiliar people. However, once she realises she’s safe, her friendly and affectionate side begins to bloom.

She’s the kind of dog who will quietly observe before stepping forward for cuddles, making every bit of trust she gives feel like a real gift.

Ebony gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a calm, understanding home where she can build confidence at her own pace.

A patient adopter will see her blossom day by day, gaining courage and showing more of her naturally kind, loyal nature.

She would especially benefit from living with a small or medium-sized resident dog who can help guide her and show her the ropes of home life.

Having a confident canine companion could help Ebony settle in faster and learn how to relax in her new environment.

Ebony is fully vaccinated and blood tested, with full rescue backup and support provided by Pennypaws Rescue. A home check via video will be required before adoption to ensure her new home is the right match.

Sweet and gentle Ebony would make a wonderful companion, and she’d make a great duo with her friend Noir. Together or on her own, she’s sure to bring warmth, quiet joy, and lasting love to the lucky family who welcomes her.

name: Floki
description:
I’m a 5 year old medium size cross breed boy.

For 3.5 years, I’ve been living in a shelter in Hungary, that’s more than half my life spent waiting behind a fence, hoping someone might stop… might notice me… might choose me. But no one ever has. Sometimes I feel invisible. I’m only 5 years old.

I’m not loud or demanding. I’m patient and quiet. I’m the kind of dog who waits in silence and hopes that one day someone will see the good boy I truly am and will not walk past me.

I love my walks, and I walk beautifully on the lead. I enjoy sniffing the world and feeling the sun on my back. I love hoomans—every scratch behind the ears and every cuddle means the world to me, because I get so little affection here.

But I treasure every moment. I never take kindness for granted.

I’m calm and peaceful around other dogs. I don’t want trouble; I just want love.

And although my muzzle is beginning to grey, please don’t think I’m old. I’m still young, playful in my soft and gentle way, and I dream—every single day—of having a home, a bed of my own, and a family who finally calls me theirs.

I have spent so long waiting, but I haven’t given up.I still believe my person is out there.

If you’re reading this… maybe it’s you.Maybe you’re the one who will make sure I’m invisible no more.

Floki is ready to travel from Hungary once the right family is found.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU passport.

name: Connie
description:
Connie is a 2 year old female Puli Cross. Her story began in a public pound, where she grew up in harsh conditions. A year ago, she was rescued in a heartbreaking state – skin and bone, frightened and frail.

With care, love, and patience, Connie has blossomed into a happy, affectionate girl. Today she’s full of life – her waggy tail never stops, she adores treats and cuddles, and she has even learned to smile when she’s with the people she loves. This beautiful girl has learned to trust again!

Connie loves the company of other dogs and is especially playful – wrestling and mingling are her favourite games! She would be just as happy snuggling up on the sofa as she is joining in on adventures.

Connie is still waiting in a small shelter in Hungary, dreaming of her forever family. She deserves a home where she will be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the sweet, resilient girl she is.

For Connie, an experienced rescue dog home would be ideal – someone patient and understanding, ready to continue guiding her on her journey.

She could live happily with another friendly and playful dog or as the only dog in the home.

2 years oldPlayful, affectionate, sociableSpayed, vaccinated, microchipped, with EU passportCan travel to the UK once her family is found

If you can give Connie the love-filled home she has been waiting for, please get in touch.

Adoption subject to home check & fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Gesztenye
description:
Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Topi
description:
Topi is a 10-month-old medium sized cross breed boy. He is a real bundle of joy, very people-centred, affectionate and kind natured. He loves cuddles, attention, and being involved in whatever his humans are doing.

Topi is lovely friendly pup who loves to run, explore and play. He learns quickly, especially when there are treats and praise involved. His eagerness to please makes him a lovely dog to train and grow with.

He would thrive with an active family who enjoys daily walks, adventures in nature or even hiking. Topi would happily join in on family outings and would love to be part of everyday life rather than left on the sidelines.

Topi is brilliant with other dogs, and enjoys playing with them. He is very sociable and makes friends easily.

He would probably be happiest living with another friendly, playful dog, but may as well enjoy being the only dog in the home, soaking up all the attention.

Because he is still young, Topi will need time and patience to settle into a new environment and learn the routines of his new home. With kindness and guidance, he will quickly blossom into a truly wonderful companion.

He could live with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to interact respectfully with a puppy. He can also be tested with cats for the right applicant.

Topi is currently in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU pet passport.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, expected to be medium-sized when fully grown.

She is currently in Hungary and is adorable and playful, as expected for her age.

Seven siblings were born in an abandoned property with their mum struggling to feed them when she was emaciated herself.

They were taken in by the local shelter at three weeks of age.

The whole litter was stunningly beautiful, and only two pups are still waiting for their families.

Maggie is fully vaccinated, free from parasites, and ready to travel. She comes with an EU passport.

She can live with dogs and older children. The right owner will need to agree to have her spayed once fully grown.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Chill
description:
Chill is a 1-year-old smaller medium-sized Puli girl with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul.

This beautiful girl was found abandoned alongside another Puli cross and taken to a kill shelter, where her future looked uncertain. Thankfully, she was given a second chance and came into our care.

When Chill first arrived, she was timid and reserved, unsure of the world around her. But once she settled into boarding and realised she was safe, her true personality slowly began to shine.

Today, her tail is up, she greets us with a smile, and every day she grows a little braver.

True to her name, Chill is exactly that – calm, quiet, easy-going and wonderfully relaxed. She is relaxed around other dogs, too and mingles beautifully with them, although she can feel overwhelmed by noisy or boisterous dogs.

She walks nicely on the lead and has a peaceful, gentle nature.

After being abandoned once, we would love her next chapter to be the one she truly deserves — a home where she will never be left behind again, where she is included in everyday life and can become a treasured member of the family.

Currently in Hungary and ready to travel to the UK once the right family is found.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Lana
description:
Lana is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl from Hungary who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown.

Lana has already had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated. Despite everything they have been through, Lana has chosen love over fear.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She has a slightly calmer nature than her sister, but still enjoys playing, exploring and having fun.

She is a sweet affectionate puppy who could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and can live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lana has never known what it’s like to belong to a family of her own, but she’s ready to learn. She dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and people to love for the rest of her life.

Lana is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown. Lucy’s had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated.

Her past could have made her fearful, but luckily it didn’t, and Lucy is full of trust and love.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She is a true puppy, full of life, loves to play and explore. She is jolly happy girl with a fun character.

Lucy is a sweet affectionate puppy, she loves dogs and could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and could live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lucy dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and a family to love for the rest of her life.

Lucy is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Audrey
description:
Audrey is a one-year-old female Labrador x Pointer Mix.

There was a moment in her life when the world showed her its harshest side. Left by the road with her siblings, Audrey was only a tiny puppy, surviving on scraps and learning far too early what it feels like to be unwanted.

She grew into a beautiful, gentle girl with a quiet kind of presence. The kind of beauty that does not ask to be noticed. The kind that reveals itself slowly, like a flower opening when it finally feels the warmth of the sun.

Audrey carries a softness that cannot be taught. A gentleness that survived everything life placed in front of her.

When she first meets you, she may watch from a small distance.

Her eyes will follow you carefully, trying to understand who you are and whether she can let herself feel safe.

And then, little by little, she begins to come closer.

A small step. A gentle wag of her tail. A softness in her eyes that was not there before. And suddenly, you realise she is beginning to trust you. With Audrey, trust is never something ordinary.

AUDREY AT A GLANCE:1 year oldMedium-sized Lab mix × English PointerGets along beautifully with other dogsGentle, calm and lovingA little shy at first, but incredibly soft once she feels safe

HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis testedMicrochippedFull RBU

Audrey is not the loudest girl in the room. She will not push herself forward or demand to be chosen.But the love she carries is deep, loyal and incredibly pure.

She needs someone who understands that the most beautiful bonds are sometimes the ones that are given time. Someone patient.

Someone kind. Someone who will let her discover, at her own pace, that she is finally home.

And when Audrey truly feels safe, we know she will give everything she has been quietly holding inside.

Her trust. Her loyalty. Her whole heart. She is a quiet soul. A gentle girl. A beautiful life waiting for the person who will help her bloom.

If something in Audrey touches your heart, please send us a message.

She is waiting for someone who will see past that first shy moment and recognise the love already waiting underneath. We would love to hear from you.

name: Orchid
description:
ORCHID – THE KIND OF LOVE THAT CHANGES A HOME!

Orchid is a one-year-old female cross breed.

She saw us… and she chose us. Inside a kill shelter, surrounded by fear, noise, and dogs slowly giving up, Orchid stepped forward with everything she had — hope, trust, and a quiet plea to be taken out of that life.

We took her. And she never looked back. From that day on, she has lived every moment as if it matters — with joy, with softness, and a kind of gratitude you can feel just by being near her.

Orchid is a gorgeous, middle-to-small sized girl, around a year old, and she carries something incredibly rare — a heart that stays open, no matter what she has been through. She is also absolutely beautiful.

Orchid is happiness you can touch. With dogs, she blends in effortlessly — playful, social, kind. With people, she becomes soft and affectionate, always close, always connected.

With children, she is pure gentleness — patient, careful, and full of love. She brings light into a space without trying. She settles into your life as if she has always been part of it.

There is no heaviness in her. Only warmth, softness, and that quiet joy that stays. Orchid is the kind of companion who doesn’t just live beside you — she becomes part of your everyday rhythm, your calm, your happiness.

A small dog with a huge heart. A soul that chose life… and never stopped being grateful for it.

ORCHID AT A GLANCE:Around 1 year oldMiddle-small sized mixed breedGets along beautifully with all dogs & cat-friendlyGentle, cuddly, joyful, full of warmthEasy-going, people-oriented, naturally well-behaved

HEALTH:Fully VaccinatedNeutering to be arranged4D TestedBrucellosis TestedMicrochippedFull RBU

If you are ready for a dog who will fill your home with warmth, closeness, and gentle joy — Orchid is waiting for you.

name: Remi
description:
REMI — THE KIND OF DOG WHO MAKES A HOUSE FEEL LIKE HOME

Remi is the kind of dog whose gentleness reaches you before anything else.

Before you notice how breathtakingly beautiful he is.

Before you notice his elegant Pointer features or his gorgeous silky coat.

The quiet warmth he carries wherever he goes.

Remi is three years old, and he is truly everything a family could hope for in a dog.

He is affectionate, beautifully mannered and wonderfully easy-going. He gets along perfectly with other dogs and has such a peaceful, balanced nature.

A softness that makes being around him feel easy.

He does not need to be loud to fill a space.

Remi is the kind of companion who would bring calm into a home, tenderness into ordinary days and the steady love only a truly good dog can give.

He is beautiful to look at, but it is his nature that stays with you.

Ready to become the dog someone will look at every day and wonder how they were ever lucky enough to find him.

Because Remi is not simply a perfect dog on paper.

He is the kind of dog who could make a home feel warmer just by being part of it.

3 years oldMedium-large, full-breed English PointerGets along beautifully with dogsCalm, gentle, affectionate and quietly joyfulWell-mannered, easy-going and a peaceful companion

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Maddie
description:
MADDIE — EVERYTHING A FAMILY COULD HOPE FOR!

The hardest thing about Maddie is knowing that a dog this beautiful inside is still waiting for someone to see her.

And she already carries the kind of nature that people spend years hoping to find in a dog.

Maddie is gentle in a way that reaches straight into your heart.

She is quiet, affectionate and soft in everything she does. She is simply a kind girl who makes being beside her feel peaceful.

And she is incredibly gentle and friendly with children.

Maddie has so much to offer a family, yet she asks for nothing more than the chance to belong to one.

A whole lifetime of loyalty, affection and companionship waiting to be given.

And somewhere, there must be a person or family whose life is missing exactly what Maddie carries.

1-year-old femaleSmall-to-medium-sized Lab mixWonderful with other dogsCat friendlyVery child-friendlyGentle, calm, affectionate and incredibly kindLead trained

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis tested

Please do not let this beautiful girl grow up without ever knowing what it feels like to be someone’s whole world.

name: Sailor
description:
SAILOR — READY TO BECOME SOMEONE’S WHOLE WORLD

Sailor is a three-year-old Lagotto mix male.

Sailor has the kind of face that stays with you.

That handsome Lagotto look that makes you stop for a moment longer every time you see him.

But Sailor is more than just a beautiful dog.

He is a wonderful three-year-old boy, full of life, love and possibility, ready to become part of someone’s world.

Beautiful, proud and incredibly handsome, with a softness about him that makes you want to reach and touch those soft curls.

Sailor is good with other dogs and enjoys canine company. He could happily share his life with a compatible dog, or finally have all the love of a family to himself.

Young enough to have years of adventures ahead of him.

Ready for long walks, new places, familiar voices and the comfort of knowing exactly where he belongs.

Sailor deserves to be more than a beautiful face people pause to admire.

He deserves to have someone learn every expression in those eyes.

To become the dog whose presence is deeply woven into a home that life without him becomes impossible to imagine.

There is an entire lifetime inside this boy.

Years of love waiting to become part of someone’s story.

Ready for someone to look at him and see their boy.

3 years oldHandsome Lagotto mixGood with other dogsLoving, beautiful and ready for family lifeStrong, striking and full of possibilityLooking for a cat-free home

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Splash
description:
Splash came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. He has struggled with kennel life and just wants a human to love.

Possibly from a working background, Splash’s prey drive is very high, and he is kept on lead and muzzled when walked but loves sprinting around in a secure field.

Splash does find a lot of things overwhelming and is looking for a calm and relaxed approach to life but with lots of fun and delicious treats at home.

Splash is very smart and does get quite excited when meeting new people. He is best suited with living teenagers and as the only animal.

He has however been walked with other sighthounds but does get over the top.

name: Pirelli
description:
Pirelli is a 2 year old male medium Lurcher.

Pirelli came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. We believe he may have been used for working as he has a high prey drive and loves playing with squeaky toys.

He is one of our longest dogs on site and although he has walked with a couple of other sighthounds, he would love to be the only animal in his new home.

He does enjoy company of older children but can jump quite high and is very leggy so would best suit a home with teenagers.

A lover of all people and very inquisitive, Pirelli is fantastic at meeting and greeting and loves to run around off lead in a secure field. He is muzzled and kept on lead when out on walks due to his prey drive.

name: Jack
description:
Meet Jack, a 6 month old male Cross-Breed expected to grow into a medium-sized dog of about 30 kilograms. He is currently being fostered in Bulgaria and will be ready to travel once his forever family is found.

Jack’s beginning was far from easy. He and his four siblings were found on the streets alongside their young mother, Lisa — barely alive, exhausted, and trying to keep her newborn puppies safe.

It’s a miracle they survived at all. Thanks to love, care, and patience, this little family recovered, and Jack is now a healthy, happy, and curious young boy.

Still a little timid around new people and situations, Jack has shown what a smart and sensitive soul he truly is. Once he feels safe, his affectionate and playful nature shines through.

He enjoys the company of other dogs, is gentle with children, and is perfectly fine around cats.

Jack loves exploring, learning new things, and being part of family life. Good on a lead, still working on hygiene habits.

He will thrive in a calm, loving home — ideally with people who have some experience with young dogs and understand that rescue dogs need time to adjust.

With patience and care, Jack will become an incredibly loyal and devoted companion.

Fully vaccinatedMicrochippedNot neutered (too young)Vet checked and tested negative for BrucellosisGood with dogs, cats, and childrenReady to travel with full DEFRA-approved paperwork and EU pet passport

Jack may have had a difficult start, but he’s ready to build a new, brighter future — full of love, safety, and adventure. Could you be the one to give this sweet boy his forever home?

name: Chiara
description:
Chiara is a 2.5 year old female Cross-Breed currently under the care of Network for Animals – Azil Danica in Bosnia. She was heartbreakingly dumped as a puppy outside the shelter with her siblings back in November 2023.

Sadly, due to a lack of promotion, she never got the chance to be adopted — but now it’s her time to shine and finally find her forever home.

Chiara weighs around 15 kilograms, making her a perfectly medium-sized girl. She’s friendly, eager to please, and walks well on the lead.

She currently shares her kennel space with three other dogs and gets along wonderfully with them. She also ignores cats, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes.

Chiara is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She’s a happy, loving girl who’s ready to start her next chapter — one filled with warmth, care, and the family she’s always deserved.

Rescue support and backup by Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Valentin
description:
Meet Valentin, a 1.5 year old male Hound Cross weighing 25 kilograms. He’s a beautiful young hound who has already been through so much in his short life.

Valentin came from a pound in northern Spain, where he was sadly stuck for six months before being rescued. Like many hounds in the region, he was likely a discarded hunting dog, but despite his past, he has kept his gentle spirit.

This lovely boy is in excellent health – he has been fully blood tested (including brucellosis), neutered, microchipped, and has his passport ready for travel.

Valentin gets along wonderfully with other dogs and would thrive in a home with canine companions. He can be a little timid when first meeting new people, but he warms up with patience and kindness and is incredibly loyal once he trusts you.

Valentin is ready to start the next chapter of his life – and he can travel! He is ready to travel, making it easier than ever to welcome him into your family.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up for life.

name: Paddy
description:
Paddy is an 8-month-old male Cross-Breed. He’s one of Bea’s five adorable puppies and has already shown himself to be a gentle and sweet-natured boy.

Despite being a little hand-shy, Paddy’s personality shines through—he just needs some time, patience, and love to help his confidence blossom.

Like many pups, Paddy is still learning about the world around him. His gentle temperament suggests he’ll grow into a loyal and affectionate companion once he settles into a secure and loving home.

He’s expected to be medium-sized when fully grown, making him the perfect balance between playful energy and easy manageability.

Currently, Paddy is in Romania, waiting eagerly for his chance to travel to the UK. With winter quickly approaching, rescuers are hoping to find him a home before the cold truly sets in.

Paddy has been fully vaccinated and blood tested, so he’s ready for his next big adventure—a forever home of his own.

Pennypaws Rescue will provide full rescue back-up and ongoing support to make sure Paddy and his future family have everything they need for a smooth transition.

A video homecheck will be required, ensuring that Paddy finds a safe, warm place where he can grow up feeling loved and secure.

name: Tosja
description:
Meet Tosja, a large gentle giant standing about 65 to 70 cm tall. She is a 4 to 5 year old female Shepherd Cross, underweight but still beautiful and strong—especially strong in her kindness, gentleness, and positivity.

She surely didn’t have an easy life. She’s so sunny, docile, confident, and affectionate—a true joy to be around. One of the most wonderful dogs in the public shelter in Romania, she is confined to a small space and only gets out for photos.

She’s amazing: balanced, loving, and playful without being pushy or annoying. Affectionate and loyal, she’s a treasure in an extra-large package with the sweetest gentle personality.

She loves every dog and person she meets. She is not cat tested, so that remains uncertain. Tosja is vaccinated and will be blood tested, including for Brucellosis, with the test sent to the UK prior to travelling.

She is neutered. From next year, dogs with cut tails and ears will not be able to travel to the UK because of new regulations coming into force. Please give her a chance—Tosja needs to travel this year.

Consider this beautiful girl; she will bring so much joy and be a wonderful companion. No small children because of her size—only someone with plenty of time and a loving home.

Adoption fee £450. Home check requested. Rescue back-up provided.

name: Bonny
description:
Welcome Bonny, one half of a brave sisterhood.

Bonny is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed, affectionate and friendly, who loves people just as much as she loves other dogs.

She and her sister Ivy were found abandoned in the middle of nowhere — two young souls lost in the fields, wandering under the burning sun with no food, no water, and no one to protect them.

They only had each other. Side by side, they faced the hardest days, finding strength in their bond and refusing to give up.

Now both girls are safe — and for the first time, they’re learning what love and care truly mean.

Bonny still looks for comfort in closeness — leaning into a kind hand or gently pressing against another dog for reassurance.

At around 10 months old, Bonny is still full of life and curiosity. She’s ready for long walks, playful moments, and quiet evenings beside someone who will finally call her their own.

Though she and Ivy shared their toughest chapter together, now it’s time for each of them to find their own forever home — a place where they’ll be loved, safe, and never alone again.

Bonny will come with a full adoption package including:

If you’ve ever wanted to open your heart to a dog who’s already proven how deeply she can love — Bonny is waiting. She survived because of love… and now she’s ready to live for it.

name: Ivy
description:
Meet Ivy, a 10 month old female Hunting Cross of medium size. She’s a playful, affectionate, and loving young girl who never lost her faith in people.

Ivy was found abandoned in a lonely field with her sister Bonny, wandering for days under the hot sun without food or water. Against all odds, she survived — and through it all, she kept her gentle, trusting nature.

Ivy is very people-oriented and adores human companionship. She’s wonderful with other dogs, greeting them with a wagging tail and plenty of puppy affection.

Despite her tough start, Ivy’s spirit shines with warmth and joy. She’s ready to leave her past behind and begin a new chapter filled with safety, comfort, and love.

Ivy will come with a full adoption package, including vaccinations, microchip, blood tests, neutering, and full rescue back-up. A home check applies.

If you’re looking for a kind-hearted, loyal companion who will brighten every single day, Ivy is waiting to meet you.

name: Conor
description:
Conor is a 3-year-old male Beagle cross Hound. This gorgeous boy weighs around 25kg and has a gentle, soulful expression that perfectly matches his kind nature.

Conor’s story started out rough — he was found wandering the streets before being taken to a pound in Galicia, Northern Spain. Sadly, he spent nearly 12 months in one of the toughest pounds in the country.

Despite that, his spirit remained unbroken, and now he’s safe in residence near Lugo, finally getting the care and kindness he deserves.

He’s a handsome hound mix who’s healthy, active, and ready for a new start. Conor is friendly with people, though a little shy when meeting new faces.

Once he feels safe, he quickly warms up and shows his affectionate, relaxed side. He’s wonderful with other dogs, enjoying playtime and socialising, and he’s been cat tested — with great results. This shows what a gentle and adaptable dog he truly is.

Conor loves being outdoors, whether he’s exploring on walks or simply enjoying fresh air in a secure garden. A secure space is essential for his safety and comfort as he continues adjusting to home life.

He’s fully neutered, vaccinated (including rabies), microchipped, and has had comprehensive blood tests for Mediterranean diseases and brucellosis.

Conor also comes with a passport and full rescue backup. Transport can be arranged anywhere in the UK, so this sweet boy can start his next chapter wherever his perfect family may be.

name: Abbie
description:
Abbie, a 3-year-old female cross-breed dog, hails from Romania, having been rescued from the Lancram shelter.

Despite her challenging beginnings, Abbie now resides in a private foster home, eagerly awaiting the opportunity to join a loving family. This small-sized cross breed, standing at 40cm in height, is adored for her sweet and kind nature.

Known for her infectious smile and enthusiastically wagging tail, Abbie thrives on human interaction and affection.

Abbie has been described as lead trained and exhibits no known allergies or intolerances. Despite her underbite, which does not cause her discomfort, she maintains a healthy appetite and enjoys normal eating and drinking habits.

Regular dental care is recommended to ensure her oral hygiene remains in good condition. Remarkably, Abbie shares her foster home with a cat and has shown no inclination towards chasing or bothering her feline companion, demonstrating her peaceful nature and adaptability.

For those interested in adopting Abbie, applications and checks are facilitated through Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

With her endearing personality and gentle demeanour, Abbie promises to bring joy and companionship to her future forever family.

name: Monty
description:
Meet Monty, a 4 year old male Sighthound who is outstanding and extremely friendly!

Monty has experienced unimaginable suffering but still forgives so much. He is looking for a wonderful and loving home.

Monty was saved from a private shelter where he received no medical treatment and little food.

It was discovered that Monty had suffered blunt trauma to his eye. Now residing in a private shelter run by a local vet in Romania, Monty is ready to find his forever home.

Monty is human-orientated, loves people, and craves human touch and contact.

He is active, playful, and a pure delight to be around. Monty shows no fear of veterinary procedures and has displayed no aggression toward carers, vets, or visitors. He is absolutely desperate for love.

Monty can live with older dog-savvy children and needs an experienced dog owner.

He requires a secure garden with 6ft fencing for play and training. A home without cats or small furries is preferable, as Monty will chase them.

Monty has been thoroughly vet-checked, and while he has a non-functional left eye, it does not cause him pain. There is a potential risk of future complications, but surgery is not recommended at this time.

Anyone who opens up their home to Monty will be truly blessed. He is a beautiful and kind-natured dog who will settle easily into a home environment.
